## foundation_documentation/modules/integrations-and-channels.md [selected; omission declared]

```text
# Module: Integrations and Channels
**Version:** 1.0

Owns Meta Cloud API, Evolution/Baileys, outbound webhooks, API keys and transport adapters.

## Invariants

- Providers are adapters; business workflows do not depend on provider payload shape.
- Secrets never enter logs, docs, fixtures or client bundles.
- Provider failures become deterministic application errors.



## Channel abstrato e envio comum — ST-CON-06

Contrato v1.3 aprovado e exercitado localmente: all93791 passou613testes, revisões independentes de aderência/segurança/cutover/TQA e Performance convergiram, com uma dívida baixa explícita de precisão de métrica de teste. O operador confirmou nova IN e resposta OUT nos vínculos oficial e não oficial após ativação das imagens atuais; a proveniência fonte→imagem→container→HTTP foi conferida antes e depois. A revisão final e os guards de closeout são registrados no [TODO governante](../todos/completed/features/TODO-leadshug-channel-abstraction.md). Evidências: [validação automatizada](../artifacts/reviews/leadshug-channel-abstraction-20261020/evidence/v13r4-final-validation.json), [ativação](../artifacts/reviews/leadshug-channel-abstraction-20261020/evidence/local-activation-provenance-v13r4-final.json), [prova assistida](../artifacts/reviews/leadshug-channel-abstraction-20261020/evidence/local-operator-proof-v13r4.json) e [proveniência posterior](../artifacts/reviews/leadshug-channel-abstraction-20261020/evidence/post-operator-readback-v13r4.json). Não é prova de produção, disponibilidade contínua ou redes futuras.

Channel is the domain text-send abstraction. TextMessage carries kind:text, opaque recipientRef and text; sendMessage returns a discriminated result. Current Meta/Evolution adapters encapsulate protocol addresses and credentials in an immutable operation instance created by an explicitly registered factory. ChannelResolver is injected through one ChannelTransportModule; existing BFF/Public/Webhooks composition shares its resolver and outbound orchestration. Common senders do not import concrete clients, switch on provider, use service location, mutate singleton credentials, or retain an old dispatch shim. Registration/protocol clients remain legitimate narrow consumers outside the common send boundary.

A server-authorized conversation/BU or accepted verified bot ingress selects the binding. The context captures channel/BU, resource identity, generation, epoch and official credential version. Before the sole external POST, local owner/identity/readiness/version checks fail closed. Same-resource REAUTORIZAR changes generation; it is distinct from a credential-version-only reseal after dispatch. Captured context is never rebound to a newer identity. No HTTP occurs in a DB transaction, and no automatic external retry or per-send external probe is introduced. The local-check-to-network interval and crash recovery remain explicit limitations.

ACCEPTED requires a valid nonempty provider message ID and does not mean handset delivery. BLOCKED occurs locally before dispatch. Meta definitive REJECTED uses only the approved stable Graph envelope allowlist; contradictory/malformed/timeout/redirect/transient results remain UNKNOWN. A supported acknowledgement without ID can yield a positively committed failed/null-ID diagnostic. Arbitrary2xx objects do not establish that acknowledgement. Legacy HTTP codes remain compatible while outcome/evidence accurately describe uncertainty. Known provider acceptance followed by any local failure remains ACCEPTED_LOCAL_INCOMPLETE, with RECORDED only on positive commit or bounded captured-key readback. No blind resend, durable outbox or null-ID echo merge is promised.

Future networks register a concrete implementation against the same narrow port. The current physical origin enum is storage provenance, not a declaration that Instagram/Messenger/Telegram identity, credentials, ingress or lifecycle are implemented. New capabilities, including template authoring/catalog/submission in ST-CON-05, require narrow contracts rather than no-op methods or concrete casts on Channel.

### Contratos de API e resultados seguros

Existing authorization remains upstream of channel resolution: session/BU grant and CSRF for BFF mutations; scoped partner key/account for the public API; accepted verified ingress for Typebot. Availability grants no access and the POST revalidates the bound context. Message and success DTOs are preserved.

| Surface | Contract addition / preserved result |
|---|---|
| GET `/api/bff/conversations/:id/messages` | `janela.disponivel:boolean`, `janela.motivo:AvailabilityReason|null`; existing `exigida`, `aberta`, `expiraEm`, `canal` and timeline pagination retained. Existing authorized read-marker semantics remain separate from observational availability. |
| POST `/api/bff/conversations/:id/messages` | Existing `{texto}` and201 `{id,canal,em}`; shared outbound policy/acceptance and safe uncertainty projection below. |
| GET `/api/v1/conversations` | Add `envio_disponivel:boolean`, `motivo_indisponibilidade:AvailabilityReason|null` per row; retain window/timeline fields. Bindings/credential metadata batched, latest-IN only for actually selected window-requiring origins. |
| GET `/api/v1/conversations/:telefone/messages` | Add `envio_disponivel`, `motivo_indisponibilidade`; existing message/window fields and scoped lookup retained. |
| POST `/api/v1/messages` | Existing numeric phone normalization, account/key scope, rate limit, `{account_id,telefone,texto,atendente?}` and201 `{ok:true,message_id,canal}` retained. Existing conversation creation before attempted send remains; first-send intent belongs to04. |
| Accepted Typebot text output | Same bound abstract send/policy, exact verified ingress, no fabricated human actor, no external replay after refusal/uncertainty/block. |

**Field Definitions**

- `AvailabilityReason`: `CANAL_AUSENTE` no binding; `CANAL_AMBIGUO` multiple bindings without selecting history; `CANAL_SELECIONADO_INDISPONIVEL` selected origin has no usable binding; `CHANNEL_IDENTITY_NOT_VERIFIED` identity proof missing; `CHANNEL_NOT_READY` connection/receipt not ready; `PENDING_CREDENTIAL` credential metadata not active; `JANELA_FECHADA` applicable free-text window closed. Available observation has `motivo=null`.
- Transport `ChannelSendResult.outcome`: `ACCEPTED` valid provider ID; `BLOCKED` local pre-dispatch failure; `REJECTED` proven synchronous refusal; `UNKNOWN` inconclusive dispatched result. Accepted does not mean handset delivery.
- Safe error `outcome`: `BLOCKED`, `REJECTED`, `UNKNOWN`, plus `AMBIGUOUS_SEND_RECORDED` only a positively committed ACK-without-ID diagnostic, and `ACCEPTED_LOCAL_INCOMPLETE` known external acceptance with incomplete local conclusion.
- `evidence`: `ACK_WITHOUT_ID` structurally supported acknowledgement missing ID, or `TRANSPORT_UNCONFIRMED` inconclusive transport result. `localMessageState` and `diagnosticPersistence`: `RECORDED` only positive commit/captured-key readback evidence; otherwise `UNCONFIRMED`. No raw provider text, token, URL, credential envelope or callback data enters these fields.

| Safe error case | HTTP/code and state |
|---|---|
| Proven refusal |400 provider mapper code, `outcome=REJECTED`, fixed refusal text. |
| Unconfirmed transport |Legacy400/code retained with `outcome=UNKNOWN`, `evidence=TRANSPORT_UNCONFIRMED`; no authoritative sent Message. A changed captured context instead takes409 `CHANNEL_CONTEXT_CHANGED`. |
| ACK without ID, positive diagnostic commit |409 `EXTERNAL_MESSAGE_ID_MISSING`, `outcome=AMBIGUOUS_SEND_RECORDED`, `evidence=ACK_WITHOUT_ID`, `diagnosticPersistence=RECORDED`; diagnostic is failed/null-ID, never a sent Message. |
| ACK without ID, diagnostic/context failure |Changed captured context takes409 `CHANNEL_CONTEXT_CHANGED`, `outcome=UNKNOWN`; other diagnostic failure takes503 `OUTBOUND_LOCAL_INCOMPLETE`, `outcome=UNKNOWN`. Persistence metadata reflects only observed commit. |
| Valid provider ID, any local acceptance/finalization failure |409 `CHANNEL_CONTEXT_CHANGED` when captured identity/generation/epoch changed; otherwise503 `OUTBOUND_LOCAL_INCOMPLETE`. Both retain `outcome=ACCEPTED_LOCAL_INCOMPLETE` and truthful `localMessageState`. No extra provider call/rebind. |

The Inbox retains drafts for every error, uses fixed safe text for uncertainty/local-incomplete outcomes, drops duplicate in-flight submit triggers and fences late body/completion effects by BU/conversation generation. Consumers must inspect outcome/evidence rather than infer rejection from a legacy400. No automatic retry is authorized.

### Consumidores seguintes e limites

ST-CON-05 preserves the user's decision that the seller creates and submits the template directly for Meta approval; no administrator intermediary is inserted. ST-CON-04 subsequently consumes eligible approved templates for first-send outside the official window and resolves contact/conversation intent/recovery semantics. Both require their own reconverged approvals. Existing public POST conversation creation before attempted send remains unchanged in06. Local test activation and assisted IN/OUT must be documented separately; no remote promotion, continuous availability or production readiness is inferred.
```

```text
# ST-CON-05 v1.1 — local activation handoff

Derived HOW preparation under the existing APROVADO, not runtime or migration evidence. Coder implementation, complete canonical `all`, independent candidate adherence/security/PCV/test-quality assurance and the accepted source freeze precede activation. Following approved Ordered Steps6–7, the final no-context review consumes the candidate assurance plus the actual activation/assisted-provider evidence before closeout. Keep one product/runtime writer. This handoff does not authorize product history, remote promotion, another credential mode or a recipient send.

This ordering corrects the first preparation draft, which placed final review before the very runtime/provider proof that it needs to assess. It changes HOW only: every required gate remains mandatory, no producer consumer is waived, no migration/runtime action starts before candidate assurance/preflight, and no completion is claimed before the final delivery review. The approval's Ordered Steps6–7 remain the authority.

## Preparation ownership

Root responsibility for this document: `operational-devops` preparation only, docker/prisma/postgresql/react/vite/nestjs source/runtime boundary. Genesis is ruled out by the existing project. Binding `environment-readiness-method.md` and `profiles/operational_devops.md` were reloaded and this document reconciled before any runtime action; the initial draft preceded that explicit reload. Existing TODO handoff remains planned for actual execution. No readiness script, image build, runtime probe/recreation, private configuration read or database command has been run for this preparation. The source executor continues separately as `operational-coder`; root returns to code-boundary peer review afterward.

Canonical context verification is already PACED-Ready. The root scripts public inventory did not expose `scripts/verify_environment.sh`; do not invoke a guessed generic helper or generate a topology from private env. The approved TODO, dependency-readiness and recorded ST-CON-06 local activation procedure identify the runtime owner and positive build/archive pattern. Fresh DevOps execution still requires its own admitted exact metadata preflight.

## Source and migration admission

Reuse the declared local `leadshug_channels_local` execution owner and the positive source archive procedure in the ST-CON-06 local activation plan. Refresh service/image/health/network/storage identities from exact project labels; old receipts are historical. Preserve PostgreSQL, Evolution/PostgreSQL, Redis, gateway and named upload storage. Never inspect, enumerate, stat, hash, archive or mount `api-app/.local-files`; never read or serialize private dotenv. No whole application-root build context or auxiliary checkout.

Freeze the final approved public source hashes and the 30 inherited seals. API/Web archives contain only Dockerfile COPY inputs, public source, pinned manifests/configuration and Prisma schema/migrations. Keep symlinks without dereferencing. Record archive/source → image → recreated container → served Web assets and exact compiled API modules. Retain prior images for rollback. Do not substitute a validation-only build, stale bundle or an old fingerprint for this proof.

Only new `*_message_template*/migration.sql` belonging to this approved feature may be pending. CREATE FUNCTION "protect_message_template_operation_identity"() RETURNS trigger AS $$
```
```text
BEGIN
  IF (NEW."id", NEW."mantenedora_id", NEW."bu_id", NEW."draft_id", NEW."actor_user_id",
      NEW."idempotency_key", NEW."request_hash", NEW."expected_fingerprint", NEW."revision",
      NEW."definition_snapshot", NEW."channel_id", NEW."provider_resource_identity_id",
      NEW."account_reference", NEW."channel_generation", NEW."pairing_epoch",
      NEW."active_credential_version", NEW."created_at") IS DISTINCT FROM
     (OLD."id", OLD."mantenedora_id", OLD."bu_id", OLD."draft_id", OLD."actor_user_id",
      OLD."idempotency_key", OLD."request_hash", OLD."expected_fingerprint", OLD."revision",
      OLD."definition_snapshot", OLD."channel_id", OLD."provider_resource_identity_id",
      OLD."account_reference", OLD."channel_generation", OLD."pairing_epoch",
      OLD."active_credential_version", OLD."created_at") THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'message template operation identity is immutable' USING ERRCODE = '23514';
  END IF;
  IF OLD."dispatch_claim_id" IS NOT NULL AND NEW."dispatch_claim_id" IS DISTINCT FROM OLD."dispatch_claim_id" THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'message template dispatch claim is immutable' USING ERRCODE = '23514';
  END IF;
  IF OLD."remote_template_id" IS NOT NULL AND NEW."remote_template_id" IS DISTINCT FROM OLD."remote_template_id" THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'message template remote identity is immutable' USING ERRCODE = '23514';
  END IF;
  IF OLD."acknowledged_remote_template_id" IS NOT NULL AND
      (NEW."acknowledged_remote_template_id" IS DISTINCT FROM OLD."acknowledged_remote_template_id"
       OR NEW."acceptance_provenance" IS DISTINCT FROM OLD."acceptance_provenance"
       OR NEW."remote_template_id" IS DISTINCT FROM OLD."remote_template_id"
       OR NEW."safe_code" IS DISTINCT FROM OLD."safe_code") THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'message template acknowledged identity is immutable' USING ERRCODE = '23514';
  END IF;
  IF NOT ((OLD."phase" = 'PREPARED' AND NEW."phase" IN ('PREPARED', 'SENDING', 'REJECTED')) OR
          (OLD."phase" = 'SENDING' AND NEW."phase" IN ('SENDING', 'ACCEPTED', 'REJECTED', 'AMBIGUOUS')) OR
          (OLD."phase" = 'AMBIGUOUS' AND NEW."phase" IN ('AMBIGUOUS', 'ACCEPTED')) OR
          (OLD."phase" = NEW."phase")) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'invalid message template operation transition' USING ERRCODE = '23514';
  END IF;
  RETURN NEW;
END;
$$ LANGUAGE plpgsql;
CREATE TRIGGER "message_template_operations_identity_immutable"
  BEFORE UPDATE ON "message_template_operations"
  FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION "protect_message_template_operation_identity"();

CREATE FUNCTION "protect_message_template_receipt_append_only"() RETURNS trigger AS $$
BEGIN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'message template receipts are append-only' USING ERRCODE = '23514';
END;
$$ LANGUAGE plpgsql;
CREATE TRIGGER "message_template_submission_receipts_append_only"
  BEFORE UPDATE OR DELETE ON "message_template_submission_receipts"
  FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION "protect_message_template_receipt_append_only"();

COMMIT;
```

## api-app/prisma/schema.prisma [selected; omission declared]

```text
model Mantenedora {
  id        String       @id @default(uuid())
  name      String
  status    TenantStatus @default(ATIVO)
  createdAt DateTime     @default(now()) @map("created_at")
  updatedAt DateTime     @updatedAt @map("updated_at")

  businessUnits BusinessUnit[]
  setores       Setor[]
  arquivos      Arquivo[]
  appUsers      AppUser[]
  apiKeys       ApiKey[]
  settings      MantenedoraSettings?
  typebotBots   TypebotBot[]
  channelRegistrationAttempts ChannelRegistrationAttempt[]
  messageTemplateDrafts MessageTemplateDraft[]
  messageTemplateOperations MessageTemplateOperation[]

  @@map("mantenedoras")
}

model Setor {
  id            String       @id @default(uuid())
  mantenedoraId String       @map("mantenedora_id")
  mantenedora   Mantenedora  @relation(fields: [mantenedoraId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  name          String
  /// INATIVO some do seletor de cadastro e marca o setor como fora de uso. NÃO
  /// interrompe atendimento: sumir com a inbox de um número por engano de
  /// cadastro seria perder conversa (ADR-0017 §1).
  status        TenantStatus @default(ATIVO)
  createdAt     DateTime     @default(now()) @map("created_at")

  businessUnits BusinessUnit[]
  grants        SetorGrant[]

  @@unique([mantenedoraId, name])
  @@map("setores")
}

model SetorGrant {
  id        String   @id @default(uuid())
  setorId   String   @map("setor_id")
  setor     Setor    @relation(fields: [setorId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  userId    String   @map("user_id")
  user      AppUser  @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  role      Role
  createdAt DateTime @default(now()) @map("created_at")

  @@unique([setorId, userId])
  @@index([userId])
  @@map("setor_grants")
}

model BusinessUnit {
  id            String       @id @default(uuid())
  mantenedoraId String       @map("mantenedora_id")
  mantenedora   Mantenedora  @relation(fields: [mantenedoraId], references: [id], onDelete: Restrict)
  /// OBRIGATÓRIO (ADR-0017 §1): número sem setor é número que nenhum atendente
  /// enxerga. Toda Mantenedora nasce com o setor `Geral`, e é nele que cai quem
  /// não escolher.
  setorId       String       @map("setor_id")
  setor         Setor        @relation(fields: [setorId], references: [id], onDelete: Restrict)
  name          String
  /// Telefone em E.164, só dígitos. Nulo enquanto o canal não informar.
  phone         String?
  status        TenantStatus @default(ATIVO)
  /// Rastreio da origem na migração (ADR-0003). Sai quando ninguém mais cruzar
  /// com o sistema antigo.
  legacyRef     String?      @map("legacy_ref")
  createdAt     DateTime     @default(now()) @map("created_at")
  updatedAt     DateTime     @updatedAt @map("updated_at")

  channels      BuChannel[]
  roles         UserBuRole[]
  conversations Conversation[]
  channelRegistrationAttempts ChannelRegistrationAttempt[]
  providerResourceIdentities ProviderResourceIdentity[]
  messageTemplateDrafts MessageTemplateDraft[]
  messageTemplateOperations MessageTemplateOperation[]
  messageTemplateObservationLeases MessageTemplateObservationLease[]

  @@unique([id, mantenedoraId])
  @@index([mantenedoraId, status])
  @@index([setorId])
  @@map("business_units")
}

enum ChannelType {
  OFICIAL
  NAO_OFICIAL
}

enum ChannelStatus {
  CONECTANDO
  CONECTADO
  DESCONECTADO
  DESLOGADO
}

model BuChannel {
  id     String       @id @default(uuid())
  buId   String       @map("bu_id")
  bu     BusinessUnit @relation(fields: [buId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  type   ChannelType
  status ChannelStatus @default(CONECTANDO)
  generation Int @default(1)
  currentAttemptId String? @unique @map("current_attempt_id")
  currentAttempt ChannelRegistrationAttempt? @relation("CurrentChannelAttempt", fields: [currentAttemptId], references: [id], onDelete: SetNull)
  pairingEpoch Int @default(0) @map("pairing_epoch")
  ownNumberVerified Boolean @default(false) @map("own_number_verified")
  verifiedEpoch Int? @map("verified_epoch")
  providerConnectionState String @default("PENDING") @map("provider_connection_state")
  receiptVerifiedAt DateTime? @map("receipt_verified_at")
  operationLeaseToken String? @map("operation_lease_token")
  operationLeaseUntil DateTime? @map("operation_lease_until")
  pendingCleanupInstanceName String? @map("pending_cleanup_instance_name")
  pendingCleanupIdentityId String? @map("pending_cleanup_identity_id")

  /// Canal OFICIAL (Meta Cloud API)
  wabaId        String? @map("waba_id")
  phoneNumberId String? @map("phone_number_id")

  /// Canal NAO_OFICIAL (Evolution API)
  evolutionInstanceName String? @unique @map("evolution_instance_name")

  /// A janela de 24h da Meta é atributo do CANAL, não do produto (ADR-0009).
  requiresWindow Boolean   @default(false) @map("requires_window")
  connectedAt    DateTime? @map("connected_at")
  createdAt      DateTime  @default(now()) @map("created_at")
  updatedAt      DateTime  @updatedAt @map("updated_at")

  credential ChannelCredential?
  attempts ChannelRegistrationAttempt[]
  providerIdentities ProviderResourceIdentity[]
  @@unique([buId, type])
  @@map("bu_channels")
}

model ChannelCredential {
  id String @id @default(uuid())
  channelId String @unique @map("channel_id")
  channel BuChannel @relation(fields: [channelId], references: [id], onDelete: Restrict)
  provider ChannelType
  buId String @map("bu_id")
  generation Int
  version Int @default(1)
  keyId String @map("key_id")
  nonce Bytes
  ciphertext Bytes
  tag Bytes
  createdAt DateTime @default(now()) @map("created_at")
  updatedAt DateTime @updatedAt @map("updated_at")

  @@index([buId, provider])
  @@map("channel_credentials")
}

model ProviderResourceIdentity {
  id String @id @default(uuid())
  provider ChannelType
  externalResourceId String @map("external_resource_id")
  buId String @map("bu_id")
  bu BusinessUnit @relation(fields: [buId], references: [id], onDelete: Restrict)
  currentChannelId String? @map("current_channel_id")
  currentChannel BuChannel? @relation(fields: [currentChannelId], references: [id], onDelete: SetNull)
  createdAt DateTime @default(now()) @map("created_at")
  retiredAt DateTime? @map("retired_at")
  managedLifecycle Boolean @default(false) @map("managed_lifecycle")
  cleanupState String @default("UNMANAGED") @map("cleanup_state")
  cleanupLeaseToken String? @map("cleanup_lease_token")
  cleanupLeaseUntil DateTime? @map("cleanup_lease_until")
  messages Message[]
  messageTemplateDrafts MessageTemplateDraft[]

  @@unique([id, buId])
  @@unique([provider, externalResourceId])
  @@index([buId])
  @@index([currentChannelId])
  @@map("provider_resource_identities")
}

enum OrigemDoGrant {
  DIRETO
  SETOR
  MANTENEDORA
}

enum Role {
  OWNER
  ADMIN
  ATENDENTE
}

model AppUser {
  id            String       @id @default(uuid())
  mantenedoraId String       @map("mantenedora_id")
  mantenedora   Mantenedora  @relation(fields: [mantenedoraId], references: [id], onDelete: Restrict)
  name          String
  email         String
  /// bcrypt (ADR-0007). Hash PBKDF2 importado é reconhecido pelo prefixo e
  /// reidratado no primeiro login.
  /// NULO enquanto o convite não foi usado (ADR-0025 §2): pessoa sem credencial
  /// existe no cadastro e não entra.
  passwordHash  String?      @map("password_hash")
  /// Só para o hash PBKDF2 legado, que guardava o salt em coluna separada.
  /// Limpo na reidratação.
  legacySalt    String?      @map("legacy_salt")
  /// Contato da pessoa, editável por ela mesma no perfil. Não é credencial e
  /// não participa de login — o e-mail é que identifica (ADR-0007).
  phone         String?
  /// Id do arquivo no armazenamento (ADR-0024), nunca um caminho.
  avatar        String?
  status        TenantStatus @default(ATIVO)
  mustChangePassword Boolean  @default(false) @map("must_change_password")
  passwordChangedAt  DateTime? @map("password_changed_at")
  createdAt          DateTime  @default(now()) @map("created_at")
  updatedAt          DateTime  @updatedAt @map("updated_at")

  roles       UserBuRole[]
  createdMessageTemplateDrafts MessageTemplateDraft[]
  messageTemplateOperations MessageTemplateOperation[]
  setorGrants SetorGrant[]
  tokens      TokenDeAcesso[]

  @@unique([id, mantenedoraId])
  @@unique([mantenedoraId, email])
  @@map("app_users")
}

model UserBuRole {
  id     String       @id @default(uuid())
  userId String       @map("user_id")
  user   AppUser      @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  buId   String       @map("bu_id")
  bu     BusinessUnit @relation(fields: [buId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  role   Role
  /// Proveniência, em PAR (ADR-0017 §2). Era um campo só, que só distinguia
  /// direto de expansão da Mantenedora; com o Setor há três origens, e o tipo
  /// precisa ser explícito. Grant DIRETO vence expansão, e revogar uma origem
  /// remove só o que ela criou.
  grantedViaTipo OrigemDoGrant @default(DIRETO) @map("granted_via_tipo")
  grantedViaId   String?       @map("granted_via_id")
  createdAt      DateTime      @default(now()) @map("created_at")

  @@unique([userId, buId])
  @@index([buId])
  @@map("user_bu_roles")
}

enum EscopoDaAtividade {
  BU
  CONTA
}

enum CategoriaDeAtividade {
  CRIAR
  EDITAR
  MOVER
  ATENDIMENTO
  TAG
  EXPORTACAO
}

enum EntidadeDaAtividade {
  CARD
  CONVERSA
  NUMERO
  SETOR
  USUARIO
  INTEGRACAO
  CONFIGURACAO
}

model ActivityLog {
  id            String   @id @default(uuid())
  mantenedoraId String   @map("mantenedora_id")

  escopo        EscopoDaAtividade
  /// Obrigatório quando escopo=BU, PROIBIDO quando escopo=CONTA. O CHECK no
  /// banco é quem cobra — não este comentário.
  buId          String?  @map("bu_id")

  userId        String?  @map("user_id")
  /// CONGELADO: o nome de quem agiu, naquele dia. Sobrevive à remoção da pessoa
  /// e ao renome de qualquer coisa.
  userName      String?  @map("user_name")
  userEmail     String?  @map("user_email")

  categoria     CategoriaDeAtividade
  entidade      EntidadeDaAtividade
  entidadeId    String?  @map("entidade_id")
  campo         String?
  de            String?
  para          String?
  /// Só para categoria que declare um formato no ADR-0022 — hoje, EXPORTACAO.
  detalhe       Json?

  /// A frase pronta, em português, CONGELADA na escrita.
  texto         String

  /// Compatibilidade com o que a v1 já gravava; some quando ninguém mais ler.
  action        String
  detail        String?
  ip            String?
  createdAt     DateTime @default(now()) @map("created_at")

  @@index([mantenedoraId, createdAt])
  @@index([entidade, entidadeId])
  @@map("activity_log")
}


enum MessageTemplateDraftState {
  DRAFT
  LOCKED
}

/// Safe local draft snapshot. Provider identities and account references stay server-side.
model MessageTemplateDraft {
  id String @id @default(uuid())
  mantenedoraId String @map("mantenedora_id")
  mantenedora Mantenedora @relation(fields: [mantenedoraId], references: [id], onDelete: Restrict, map: "mt_draft_mantenedora_fkey")
  buId String @map("bu_id")
  bu BusinessUnit @relation(fields: [buId, mantenedoraId], references: [id, mantenedoraId], onDelete: Restrict, map: "mt_draft_bu_fkey")
  creatorUserId String @map("creator_user_id")
  creator AppUser @relation(fields: [creatorUserId, mantenedoraId], references: [id, mantenedoraId], onDelete: Restrict, map: "mt_draft_creator_fkey")
  /// Historical immutable BuChannel id; the channel row is transient and may be detached.
  channelId String @map("channel_id")
  providerResourceIdentityId String @map("provider_resource_identity_id")
  providerResourceIdentity ProviderResourceIdentity @relation(fields: [providerResourceIdentityId, buId], references: [id, buId], onDelete: Restrict, map: "mt_draft_identity_fkey")
  accountReference String @map("account_reference") @db.VarChar(128)
  channelGeneration Int @map("channel_generation")
  pairingEpoch Int @map("pairing_epoch")
  activeCredentialVersion Int? @map("active_credential_version")
  clientRequestId String @map("client_request_id") @db.VarChar(128)
  requestHash String @map("request_hash") @db.Char(64)
  state MessageTemplateDraftState @default(DRAFT)
  revision Int @default(1)
  definition Json
  createdAt DateTime @default(now()) @map("created_at")
  updatedAt DateTime @updatedAt @map("updated_at")
  revisions MessageTemplateRevision[]
  operations MessageTemplateOperation[]

  @@unique([id, buId, mantenedoraId], map: "mt_draft_id_bu_tenant_uq")

  @@unique([buId, creatorUserId, clientRequestId], map: "mt_draft_bu_creator_req_uq")
  @@index([buId, creatorUserId, createdAt, id], map: "mt_draft_bu_creator_created_idx")
  @@index([buId, createdAt, id], map: "mt_draft_bu_created_idx")
  @@map("message_template_drafts")
}

model MessageTemplateRevision {
  id String @id @default(uuid())
  draftId String @map("draft_id")
  draft MessageTemplateDraft @relation(fields: [draftId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade, map: "mt_revision_draft_fkey")
  revision Int
  definition Json
  createdAt DateTime @default(now()) @map("created_at")

  @@unique([draftId, revision], map: "mt_revision_draft_rev_uq")
  @@map("message_template_revisions")
}

enum MessageTemplateOperationPhase {
  PREPARED
  SENDING
  ACCEPTED
  REJECTED
  AMBIGUOUS
}

enum MessageTemplateAcceptanceProvenance {
  ACKNOWLEDGED
  CORRELATED_BY_DEFINITION
}

/// Durable, immutable submit intent. The provider request is always derived
/// from this snapshot and can never be rebound to a later credential/account.
model MessageTemplateOperation {
  id String @id @default(uuid())
  mantenedoraId String @map("mantenedora_id")
  mantenedora Mantenedora @relation(fields: [mantenedoraId], references: [id], onDelete: Restrict, map: "mt_ops_mantenedora_fkey")
  buId String @map("bu_id")
  bu BusinessUnit @relation(fields: [buId, mantenedoraId], references: [id, mantenedoraId], onDelete: Restrict, map: "mt_ops_bu_fkey")
  draftId String @map("draft_id")
  draft MessageTemplateDraft @relation(fields: [draftId, buId, mantenedoraId], references: [id, buId, mantenedoraId], onDelete: Restrict, map: "mt_ops_draft_fkey")
  actorUserId String @map("actor_user_id")
  actor AppUser @relation(fields: [actorUserId, mantenedoraId], references: [id, mantenedoraId], onDelete: Restrict, map: "mt_ops_actor_fkey")
  idempotencyKey String @map("idempotency_key") @db.Uuid
  requestHash String @map("request_hash") @db.Char(64)
  expectedFingerprint String @map("expected_fingerprint") @db.Char(64)
  revision Int
  definitionSnapshot Json @map("definition_snapshot")
  channelId String @map("channel_id")
  providerResourceIdentityId String @map("provider_resource_identity_id")
  accountReference String @map("account_reference") @db.VarChar(128)
  channelGeneration Int @map("channel_generation")
  pairingEpoch Int @map("pairing_epoch")
  activeCredentialVersion Int? @map("active_credential_version")
  phase MessageTemplateOperationPhase @default(PREPARED)
  version Int @default(1)
  dispatchClaimId String? @unique(map: "mt_ops_dispatch_claim_uq") @map("dispatch_claim_id") @db.Uuid
  leaseOwnerId String? @map("lease_owner_id") @db.Uuid
  leaseUntil DateTime? @map("lease_until")
  recoveryOwnerId String? @map("recovery_owner_id") @db.Uuid
  recoveryLeaseUntil DateTime? @map("recovery_lease_until")
  remoteTemplateId String? @map("remote_template_id") @db.VarChar(128)
  acknowledgedRemoteTemplateId String? @map("acknowledged_remote_template_id") @db.VarChar(128)
  safeCode String? @map("safe_code") @db.VarChar(64)
  providerStatus String? @map("provider_status") @db.VarChar(32)
  acceptanceProvenance MessageTemplateAcceptanceProvenance? @map("acceptance_provenance")
  createdAt DateTime @default(now()) @map("created_at")
  updatedAt DateTime @updatedAt @map("updated_at")
  receipts MessageTemplateSubmissionReceipt[]
  reservation MessageTemplateNameReservation?
  quotaEvents MessageTemplateQuotaEvent[]

  @@unique([buId, actorUserId, idempotencyKey], map: "mt_ops_bu_actor_key_uq")
  @@unique([draftId, revision], map: "mt_ops_draft_revision_uq")
  @@index([buId, actorUserId, createdAt, id], map: "mt_ops_bu_actor_created_idx")
  @@index([accountReference, phase, leaseUntil], map: "mt_ops_account_phase_lease_idx")
  @@index([phase, recoveryLeaseUntil], map: "mt_ops_recovery_lease_idx")
  @@map("message_template_operations")
}

/// Append-only evidence; APIs project the latest ten without deleting history.
model MessageTemplateSubmissionReceipt {
  id String @id @default(uuid())
  operationId String @map("operation_id")
  operation MessageTemplateOperation @relation(fields: [operationId], references: [id], onDelete: Restrict, map: "mt_receipt_operation_fkey")
  sequence Int
  phase MessageTemplateOperationPhase
  safeCode String? @map("safe_code") @db.VarChar(64)
  remoteTemplateId String? @map("remote_template_id") @db.VarChar(128)
  acceptanceProvenance MessageTemplateAcceptanceProvenance? @map("acceptance_provenance")
  createdAt DateTime @default(now()) @map("created_at")

  @@unique([operationId, sequence], map: "mt_receipt_op_sequence_uq")
  @@index([operationId, createdAt, id], map: "mt_receipt_op_created_idx")
  @@map("message_template_submission_receipts")
}

/// Global account/name lock contains no tenant payload or user-visible ids.
model MessageTemplateNameReservation {
  id String @id @default(uuid())
  accountReference String @map("account_reference") @db.VarChar(128)
  name String @db.VarChar(128)
  language String @db.VarChar(35)
  operationId String @unique(map: "mt_res_operation_uq") @map("operation_id")
  operation MessageTemplateOperation @relation(fields: [operationId], references: [id], onDelete: Restrict, map: "mt_reservation_operation_fkey")
  createdAt DateTime @default(now()) @map("created_at")

  @@unique([accountReference, name, language], map: "mt_res_account_name_lang_uq")
  @@index([accountReference, createdAt], map: "mt_res_account_created_idx")
  @@map("message_template_name_reservations")
}

/// Durable events counted under per-scope advisory locks for exact sliding windows.
model MessageTemplateQuotaEvent {
  id String @id @default(uuid())
  kind String @db.VarChar(16)
  scopeKey String @map("scope_key") @db.VarChar(128)
  operationId String? @map("operation_id")
  operation MessageTemplateOperation? @relation(fields: [operationId], references: [id], onDelete: Restrict, map: "mt_quota_operation_fkey")
  occurredAt DateTime @default(now()) @map("occurred_at")

  @@unique([kind, operationId], map: "mt_quota_kind_operation_uq")
  @@index([kind, scopeKey, occurredAt], map: "mt_quota_scope_time_idx")
  @@map("message_template_quota_events")
}

/// One lease/fence shared by individual refresh and each explicit catalogue page.
model MessageTemplateObservationLease {
  contextKey String @id @map("context_key") @db.Char(64)
  mantenedoraId String @map("mantenedora_id")
  buId String @map("bu_id")
  bu BusinessUnit @relation(fields: [buId, mantenedoraId], references: [id, mantenedoraId], onDelete: Restrict, map: "mt_lease_bu_fkey")
  channelId String @map("channel_id")
  accountReference String @map("account_reference") @db.VarChar(128)
  channelGeneration Int @map("channel_generation")
  pairingEpoch Int @map("pairing_epoch")
  providerResourceIdentityId String @map("provider_resource_identity_id")
  activeCredentialVersion Int @map("active_credential_version")
  ownerId String? @map("owner_id") @db.Uuid
  fence BigInt @default(0)
  leaseUntil DateTime? @map("lease_until")
  lastStartedAt DateTime? @map("last_started_at")
  updatedAt DateTime @updatedAt @map("updated_at")
  observations MessageTemplateRemoteObservation[]
  pages MessageTemplateCatalogPage[]

  @@index([accountReference, leaseUntil], map: "mt_lease_account_expiry_idx")
  @@map("message_template_observation_leases")
}

/// The single semantic observation projector for both draft and catalog views.
model MessageTemplateRemoteObservation {
  id String @id @default(uuid())
  contextKey String @map("context_key") @db.Char(64)
  lease MessageTemplateObservationLease @relation(fields: [contextKey], references: [contextKey], onDelete: Restrict, map: "mt_observation_lease_fkey")
  remoteTemplateId String @map("remote_template_id") @db.VarChar(128)
  status String @db.VarChar(32)
  name String? @db.VarChar(128)
  language String? @db.VarChar(35)
  category String @db.VarChar(32)
  parameterFormat String @map("parameter_format") @db.VarChar(16)
  components Json
  semanticFingerprint String? @map("semantic_fingerprint") @db.Char(64)
  supported Boolean @default(false)
  available Boolean @default(true)
  safeCode String? @map("safe_code") @db.VarChar(64)
  observedEligible Boolean @default(false) @map("observed_eligible")
  observedAt DateTime @map("observed_at")
  observedFence BigInt @map("observed_fence")
  updatedAt DateTime @updatedAt @map("updated_at")

  @@unique([contextKey, remoteTemplateId], map: "mt_observation_context_remote_uq")
  @@index([contextKey, status, observedAt], map: "mt_observation_status_time_idx")
  @@map("message_template_remote_observations")
}

/// Cached explicit catalogue pages; GET never fans out to the provider.
model MessageTemplateCatalogPage {
  id String @id @default(uuid())
  contextKey String @map("context_key") @db.Char(64)
  lease MessageTemplateObservationLease @relation(fields: [contextKey], references: [contextKey], onDelete: Restrict, map: "mt_page_lease_fkey")
  cursorHash String @map("cursor_hash") @db.Char(64)
  requestedCursor String? @map("requested_cursor") @db.VarChar(512)
  remoteTemplateIds Json @map("remote_template_ids")
  nextCursor String? @map("next_cursor") @db.VarChar(512)
  available Boolean @default(true)
  safeCode String? @map("safe_code") @db.VarChar(64)
  observedAt DateTime @map("observed_at")
  observedFence BigInt @map("observed_fence")

  @@unique([contextKey, cursorHash], map: "mt_page_context_cursor_uq")
  @@index([contextKey, observedAt], map: "mt_page_context_time_idx")
  @@map("message_template_catalog_pages")
}
```

## api-app/src/domain/channels/channel-credential-resolver.spec.ts

```text
import { randomBytes } from 'node:crypto';
import { afterEach, describe, expect, it, vi } from 'vitest';
import { sealChannelCredential } from './channel-credential-crypto';
import { ChannelCredentialResolver } from './channel-credential-resolver';

describe('ChannelCredentialResolver purpose template-management', () => {
  afterEach(() => {
    delete process.env.CHANNEL_CREDENTIAL_KEY_ID;
    delete process.env.CHANNEL_CREDENTIAL_KEY;
  });

  it('reuses the sole credential owner without the messaging readiness gate', async () => {
    const key = randomBytes(32);
    process.env.CHANNEL_CREDENTIAL_KEY_ID = 'fixture-key';
    process.env.CHANNEL_CREDENTIAL_KEY = key.toString('base64');
    const credential = sealChannelCredential('scoped-fixture-token', 'fixture-key', key, {
      purpose: 'active', provider: 'OFICIAL', buId: 'bu-1', channelId: 'channel-1', generation: 4, version: 7,
    });
    const prisma = {
      buChannel: { findUnique: vi.fn().mockResolvedValue({
        id: 'channel-1', buId: 'bu-1', type: 'OFICIAL', generation: 4, pairingEpoch: 8,
        ownNumberVerified: true, verifiedEpoch: 8, status: 'DESCONECTADO', receiptVerifiedAt: null,
        providerConnectionState: 'DISCONNECTED', phoneNumberId: 'phone-1', wabaId: 'waba-1',
        credential: { ...credential, provider: 'OFICIAL', buId: 'bu-1', generation: 4, version: 7 },
        providerIdentities: [{ id: 'identity-1', currentChannelId: 'channel-1', managedLifecycle: true, provider: 'OFICIAL', buId: 'bu-1', externalResourceId: 'phone-1' }],
      }) },
    };
    const resolver = new ChannelCredentialResolver(prisma as never);

    await expect(resolver.resolve('channel-1', 'template-management')).resolves.toMatchObject({
      provider: 'OFICIAL', buId: 'bu-1', channelId: 'channel-1', generation: 4, pairingEpoch: 8,
      providerResourceIdentityId: 'identity-1', activeCredentialVersion: 7,
      accessToken: 'scoped-fixture-token', phoneNumberId: 'phone-1', wabaId: 'waba-1',
    });
  });

  it('does not let template-management bypass official identity verification', async () => {
    const prisma = { buChannel: { findUnique: vi.fn().mockResolvedValue({
      id: 'channel-1', buId: 'bu-1', type: 'NAO_OFICIAL', generation: 1, pairingEpoch: 1,
      ownNumberVerified: true, verifiedEpoch: 1, status: 'CONECTADO', receiptVerifiedAt: new Date(),
      providerConnectionState: 'CONNECTED', credential: null,
      providerIdentities: [{ id: 'identity-1', currentChannelId: 'channel-1', managedLifecycle: true, provider: 'NAO_OFICIAL', buId: 'bu-1', externalResourceId: 'instance-1' }],
    }) } };
    const resolver = new ChannelCredentialResolver(prisma as never);
    await expect(resolver.resolve('channel-1', 'template-management')).rejects.toMatchObject({
      response: { code: 'TEMPLATE_MANAGEMENT_UNAVAILABLE' },
    });
  });

  it('fails closed when the active credential tenant/provider binding differs', async () => {
    const key = randomBytes(32);
    process.env.CHANNEL_CREDENTIAL_KEY_ID = 'fixture-key';
    process.env.CHANNEL_CREDENTIAL_KEY = key.toString('base64');
    const envelope = sealChannelCredential('scoped-fixture-token', 'fixture-key', key, {
      purpose: 'active', provider: 'OFICIAL', buId: 'other-bu', channelId: 'channel-1', generation: 4, version: 7,
    });
    const prisma = { buChannel: { findUnique: vi.fn().mockResolvedValue({
      id: 'channel-1', buId: 'bu-1', type: 'OFICIAL', generation: 4, pairingEpoch: 8,
      ownNumberVerified: true, verifiedEpoch: 8, status: 'DESCONECTADO', credential: { ...envelope, provider: 'OFICIAL', buId: 'other-bu', generation: 4, version: 7 },
      providerIdentities: [{ id: 'identity-1', currentChannelId: 'channel-1', managedLifecycle: true, provider: 'OFICIAL', buId: 'bu-1', externalResourceId: 'phone-1' }],
    }) } };
    await expect(new ChannelCredentialResolver(prisma as never).resolve('channel-1', 'template-management'))
      .rejects.toMatchObject({ response: { code: 'PENDING_CREDENTIAL' } });
  });
});
```

## api-app/src/domain/channels/channel-credential-resolver.ts

```text
import { ConflictException, Injectable } from '@nestjs/common';
import type { Prisma } from '@prisma/client';
import { PrismaService } from '../../infra/prisma/prisma.service';
import { loadChannelCredentialKey, openChannelCredential } from './channel-credential-crypto';

export interface ResolvedChannelCredential {
  channelId: string;
  buId: string;
  provider: 'OFICIAL' | 'NAO_OFICIAL';
  generation: number;
  pairingEpoch: number;
  providerResourceIdentityId: string;
  externalResourceId: string;
  activeCredentialVersion: number | null;
  accessToken?: string;
  phoneNumberId?: string;
  wabaId?: string;
  evolutionInstanceName?: string;
}

/** Resolves only a currently verified, owned channel and decrypts its own credential. */
@Injectable()
export class ChannelCredentialResolver {
  constructor(private readonly prisma: PrismaService) {}

  /** Metadata-only check for GET availability; it never decrypts the credential. */
  async inspectActiveCredential(
    channelId: string,
    generation: number,
    expected?: { readonly provider: 'OFICIAL' | 'NAO_OFICIAL'; readonly buId: string },
    transaction?: Prisma.TransactionClient,
  ): Promise<{ version: number | null; ready: boolean }> {
    if (!transaction) return (await this.inspectActiveCredentials([{ channelId, generation, ...expected }])).get(channelId) ?? { version: null, ready: false };
    const credential = await transaction.channelCredential.findUnique({
      where: { channelId }, select: { version: true, generation: true, keyId: true, provider: true, buId: true },
    });
    let currentKeyId: string | null = null;
    try { currentKeyId = loadChannelCredentialKey(process.env).keyId; } catch { /* absent key makes the credential unavailable */ }
    const ready = Boolean(credential && currentKeyId && credential.keyId === currentKeyId
      && credential.generation === generation && (!expected?.provider || credential.provider === expected.provider)
      && (!expected?.buId || credential.buId === expected.buId));
    return { version: credential?.version ?? null, ready };
  }

  /** One metadata-only credential read for a public conversation page. */
  async inspectActiveCredentials(bindings: readonly { channelId: string; generation: number; provider?: 'OFICIAL' | 'NAO_OFICIAL'; buId?: string }[]): Promise<Map<string, { version: number | null; ready: boolean }>> {
    const ids = [...new Set(bindings.map((binding) => binding.channelId))];
    if (!ids.length) return new Map();
    const credentials = await this.prisma.channelCredential.findMany({
      where: { channelId: { in: ids } }, select: { channelId: true, version: true, generation: true, keyId: true, provider: true, buId: true },
    });
    let currentKeyId: string | null = null;
    try {
      currentKeyId = loadChannelCredentialKey(process.env).keyId;
    } catch { /* absent key makes every official channel unavailable */ }
    const byId = new Map(credentials.map((credential) => [credential.channelId, credential]));
    return new Map(bindings.map(({ channelId, generation, provider, buId }) => {
      const credential = byId.get(channelId);
      return [channelId, {
        version: credential?.version ?? null,
        ready: Boolean(credential && credential.generation === generation && currentKeyId && credential.keyId === currentKeyId
          && (!provider || credential.provider === provider) && (!buId || credential.buId === buId)),
      }];
    }));
  }

  async resolve(channelId: string, purpose: 'send' | 'registration' | 'verify' | 'template-management' = 'send'): Promise<ResolvedChannelCredential> {
    const channel = await this.prisma.buChannel.findUnique({
      where: { id: channelId }, include: { credential: true, providerIdentities: true },
    });
    if (!channel || (purpose !== 'verify' && (!channel.ownNumberVerified || channel.verifiedEpoch !== channel.pairingEpoch))) {
      throw new ConflictException({ code: 'CHANNEL_IDENTITY_NOT_VERIFIED' });
    }
    if (purpose === 'send' && (channel.status !== 'CONECTADO' || !channel.receiptVerifiedAt
      || (channel.type === 'OFICIAL' && channel.providerConnectionState !== 'SUBSCRIBED')
      || (channel.type === 'NAO_OFICIAL' && channel.providerConnectionState !== 'CONNECTED'))) {
      throw new ConflictException({ code: 'CHANNEL_NOT_READY' });
    }
    if (purpose === 'template-management' && channel.type !== 'OFICIAL') {
      throw new ConflictException({ code: 'TEMPLATE_MANAGEMENT_UNAVAILABLE' });
    }
    const identity = channel.providerIdentities.find((row) => row.currentChannelId === channel.id);
    if (!identity || !identity.managedLifecycle || identity.provider !== channel.type || identity.buId !== channel.buId) {
      throw new ConflictException({ code: 'CHANNEL_IDENTITY_NOT_VERIFIED' });
    }
    const result: ResolvedChannelCredential = {
      channelId: channel.id, buId: channel.buId, provider: channel.type, generation: channel.generation,
      pairingEpoch: channel.pairingEpoch, providerResourceIdentityId: identity.id,
      externalResourceId: identity.externalResourceId,
      activeCredentialVersion: channel.type === 'OFICIAL' ? channel.credential?.version ?? null : null,
      ...(channel.phoneNumberId ? { phoneNumberId: channel.phoneNumberId } : {}),
      ...(channel.wabaId ? { wabaId: channel.wabaId } : {}),
      ...(channel.evolutionInstanceName ? { evolutionInstanceName: channel.evolutionInstanceName } : {}),
    };
    if (channel.type === 'OFICIAL') {
      if (!channel.credential || channel.credential.generation !== channel.generation
        || (purpose === 'template-management' && (channel.credential.provider !== channel.type || channel.credential.buId !== channel.buId))) {
        throw new ConflictException({ code: 'PENDING_CREDENTIAL' });
      }
      const { keyId, key } = loadChannelCredentialKey(process.env);
      if (channel.credential.keyId !== keyId) throw new ConflictException({ code: 'PENDING_CREDENTIAL' });
      const plaintext = openChannelCredential({
        ...channel.credential, nonce: Buffer.from(channel.credential.nonce),
        ciphertext: Buffer.from(channel.credential.ciphertext), tag: Buffer.from(channel.credential.tag),
      }, new Map([[keyId, key]]), {
        purpose: 'active', provider: channel.type, buId: channel.buId, channelId: channel.id,
        generation: channel.generation, version: channel.credential.version,
      });
      result.accessToken = plaintext.toString('utf8');
    }
    return result;
  }
}
```

## api-app/src/domain/historico/catalogo.ts

```text
/**
 * O catálogo de ações rastreáveis (ADR-0022).
 *
 * Ele é a lista, e a lista é a decisão: **ação que muda estado de negócio e não
 * está aqui não está rastreada**. O modo de falhar é silencioso — a ausência de
 * uma linha não gera sintoma, e ninguém abre o histórico e percebe que falta o
 * que nunca foi escrito. Por isso a §4 do ADR exige verificação mecânica, e ela
 * está em `cobertura.ts`.
 */

export type Categoria = 'CRIAR' | 'EDITAR' | 'MOVER' | 'ATENDIMENTO' | 'TAG' | 'EXPORTACAO';
export type Entidade = 'CARD' | 'CONVERSA' | 'NUMERO' | 'SETOR' | 'USUARIO' | 'INTEGRACAO' | 'CONFIGURACAO';
export type Escopo = 'BU' | 'CONTA';

export interface AcaoDoCatalogo {
  categoria: Categoria;
  entidade: Entidade;
  /**
   * `BU` quando a ação é sobre um número, uma conversa ou o que pendura neles;
   * `CONTA` quando é sobre a Mantenedora. Errar aqui não produz linha errada:
   * produz `INSERT` recusado pelo CHECK (ADR-0020 §1.1).
   */
  escopo: Escopo;
  frase: (d: Record<string, string | undefined>) => string;
}

const t = (v: string | undefined) => v ?? '—';

export const CATALOGO = {
  // --- Setor (ADR-0017) ---
  'setor.criado':    { categoria: 'CRIAR',  entidade: 'SETOR',  escopo: 'CONTA', frase: (d) => `criou o setor ${t(d.nome)}` },
  'setor.renomeado': { categoria: 'EDITAR', entidade: 'SETOR',  escopo: 'CONTA', frase: (d) => `renomeou o setor de ${t(d.de)} para ${t(d.para)}` },
  'setor.status':    { categoria: 'EDITAR', entidade: 'SETOR',  escopo: 'CONTA', frase: (d) => `${d.para === 'INATIVO' ? 'inativou' : 'reativou'} o setor ${t(d.nome)}` },
  'setor.excluido':  { categoria: 'EDITAR', entidade: 'SETOR',  escopo: 'CONTA', frase: (d) => `excluiu o setor ${t(d.nome)}` },
  // A linha mais importante do catálogo: é a única escrita que reescreve
  // permissão de gente que não está na requisição (ADR-0017 §2, regra 5). Sem
  // registro, uma perda de acesso não tem autor.
  'numero.movido':   { categoria: 'MOVER',  entidade: 'NUMERO', escopo: 'BU',    frase: (d) => `moveu o número ${t(d.nome)} do setor ${t(d.de)} para ${t(d.para)}` },

  // --- Número e canal (ADR-0008) ---
  'numero.criado':   { categoria: 'CRIAR',  entidade: 'NUMERO', escopo: 'BU', frase: (d) => `cadastrou o número ${t(d.nome)}` },
  'numero.editado':  { categoria: 'EDITAR', entidade: 'NUMERO', escopo: 'BU', frase: (d) => (d.campo === 'nome' ? `renomeou o número de ${t(d.de)} para ${t(d.para)}` : d.para === 'INATIVO' ? `inativou o número ${t(d.nome)}` : `reativou o número ${t(d.nome)}`) },
  'canal.conectado': { categoria: 'CRIAR',  entidade: 'NUMERO', escopo: 'BU', frase: (d) => `conectou o canal ${t(d.canal)} no número ${t(d.nome)}` },
  'canal.onboarding.iniciado': { categoria: 'CRIAR', entidade: 'NUMERO', escopo: 'BU', frase: (d) => `iniciou o cadastro do canal ${t(d.canal)} no número ${t(d.nome)}` },
  'canal.onboarding.atualizado': { categoria: 'EDITAR', entidade: 'NUMERO', escopo: 'BU', frase: (d) => `atualizou o cadastro do canal ${t(d.canal)} no número ${t(d.nome)}` },
  'canal.pareado': { categoria: 'EDITAR', entidade: 'NUMERO', escopo: 'BU', frase: (d) => `pareou o canal ${t(d.canal)} no número ${t(d.nome)}` },
  'canal.identidade.verificada': { categoria: 'EDITAR', entidade: 'NUMERO', escopo: 'BU', frase: (d) => `verificou a identidade do canal ${t(d.canal)} no número ${t(d.nome)}` },
  'canal.removido':  { categoria: 'EDITAR', entidade: 'NUMERO', escopo: 'BU', frase: (d) => `removeu o canal ${t(d.canal)} do número ${t(d.nome)}` },

  // --- Pessoas e acesso (ADR-0018). Sempre CONTA: o sujeito é a pessoa, que
  // pertence à Mantenedora e não a um número — mesmo quando o objeto é uma BU.
  'usuario.criado':      { categoria: 'CRIAR',  entidade: 'USUARIO', escopo: 'CONTA', frase: (d) => `convidou ${t(d.email)} como ${t(d.papel)}` },
  'usuario.papel':       { categoria: 'EDITAR', entidade: 'USUARIO', escopo: 'CONTA', frase: (d) => `alterou o papel de ${t(d.nome)} de ${t(d.de)} para ${t(d.para)}` },
  'usuario.atualizado':  { categoria: 'EDITAR', entidade: 'USUARIO', escopo: 'CONTA', frase: (d) => `atualizou o cadastro de ${t(d.nome)}` },
  'usuario.senha':       { categoria: 'EDITAR', entidade: 'USUARIO', escopo: 'CONTA', frase: (d) => `reenviou o acesso de ${t(d.nome)}` },
  'acesso.concedido':    { categoria: 'EDITAR', entidade: 'USUARIO', escopo: 'CONTA', frase: (d) => `concedeu a ${t(d.nome)} acesso ao setor ${t(d.setor)}` },
  'acesso.revogado':     { categoria: 'EDITAR', entidade: 'USUARIO', escopo: 'CONTA', frase: (d) => `revogou de ${t(d.nome)} o acesso ao setor ${t(d.setor)}` },

  // --- Configuração e integração (ADR-0016) ---
  'mantenedora.criada': { categoria: 'CRIAR',  entidade: 'CONFIGURACAO', escopo: 'BU',    frase: (d) => `criou a conta ${t(d.nome)}` },
  'mantenedora.configurada': { categoria: 'CRIAR',  entidade: 'CONFIGURACAO', escopo: 'CONTA', frase: () => `concluiu a configuração inicial` },
  'mantenedora.modulos':      { categoria: 'EDITAR', entidade: 'CONFIGURACAO', escopo: 'CONTA', frase: () => `alterou os módulos e a marca da conta` },
  'integracao.chave.criada':   { categoria: 'CRIAR',  entidade: 'INTEGRACAO', escopo: 'CONTA', frase: (d) => `criou a chave de API ${t(d.nome)}` },
  'integracao.chave.revogada': { categoria: 'EDITAR', entidade: 'INTEGRACAO', escopo: 'CONTA', frase: (d) => `revogou a chave de API ${t(d.nome)}` },
  'integracao.typebot.gatilho.criado': { categoria: 'CRIAR', entidade: 'INTEGRACAO', escopo: 'CONTA', frase: (d) => `configurou o gatilho do Typebot ${t(d.bot)}` },
  'integracao.typebot.gatilho.status': { categoria: 'EDITAR', entidade: 'INTEGRACAO', escopo: 'CONTA', frase: (d) => `${d.para === 'ATIVO' ? 'ativou' : 'desativou'} o gatilho do Typebot ${t(d.bot)}` },
  'integracao.webhook':        { categoria: 'EDITAR', entidade: 'INTEGRACAO', escopo: 'CONTA', frase: () => `alterou a URL do webhook de saída` },

  // --- Templates oficiais: rastrear intenção sem registrar definição, exemplos ou credenciais ---
  'template.rascunho.criado': { categoria: 'CRIAR', entidade: 'INTEGRACAO', escopo: 'BU', frase: () => `criou um rascunho de template oficial` },
  'template.revisao.salva': { categoria: 'EDITAR', entidade: 'INTEGRACAO', escopo: 'BU', frase: () => `salvou uma revisão de template oficial` },
  'template.submissao.iniciada': { categoria: 'CRIAR', entidade: 'INTEGRACAO', escopo: 'BU', frase: () => `iniciou uma operação de template oficial` },
  'template.operacao.reconciliada': { categoria: 'EDITAR', entidade: 'INTEGRACAO', escopo: 'BU', frase: () => `reconciliou uma operação de template oficial` },

  // --- Atendimento (ADR-0009) ---
  'atendimento.assumido':  { categoria: 'ATENDIMENTO', entidade: 'CONVERSA', escopo: 'BU', frase: (d) => `assumiu o atendimento de ${t(d.contato)}` },
  'atendimento.encerrado': { categoria: 'ATENDIMENTO', entidade: 'CONVERSA', escopo: 'BU', frase: (d) => `encerrou o atendimento de ${t(d.contato)}` },

  // --- Exportação: a EXCEÇÃO ao princípio "leitura não registra" (ADR-0022 §3).
  // É a única leitura que produz uma cópia do dado FORA do produto, e a primeira
  // pergunta de qualquer apuração de vazamento.
  'exportacao.historico': { categoria: 'EXPORTACAO', entidade: 'CONVERSA', escopo: 'BU', frase: (d) => `exportou ${t(d.quantidade)} mensagens do número ${t(d.nome)}` },
} as const satisfies Record<string, AcaoDoCatalogo>;

export type ChaveDoCatalogo = keyof typeof CATALOGO;
```

```text
import { ChaveDoCatalogo } from './catalogo';

/**
 * A regra de manutenção do catálogo (ADR-0022 §4), em forma executável.
 *
 * > Toda rota que escreve dado de negócio nasce com a sua linha no catálogo, ou
 * > com a justificativa de por que não tem — no mesmo commit.
 *
 * O teste em `test/cobertura-do-catalogo.e2e-spec.ts` percorre as rotas de
 * escrita de verdade, do roteador em execução, e **falha** quando alguma não
 * está aqui. É o que impede o catálogo de envelhecer em silêncio: a ausência de
 * uma linha de rastro não gera sintoma, e ninguém descobre pelo uso.
 */
export type Cobertura = { registra: ChaveDoCatalogo[] } | { isento: string };

export const COBERTURA_DE_ROTAS: Record<string, Cobertura> = {
  // --- BFF: identidade ---
  'POST /api/bff/auth/login': {

      'LoginAttempt guarda só falhas. Precisa de decisão.',
  },

    isento:

      'entra: é `usuario.atualizado`, e é poder exercido sobre terceiro.',

    isento:

      'bem-sucedido, que segue sem decisão.',
```

## api-app/src/domain/message-templates/template-definition.spec.ts

```text
import { describe, expect, it } from 'vitest';
import {
  createTemplatePreview,
  normalizeTemplateDefinition,
  normalizeTemplateName,
  TemplateDefinitionError,
} from './template-definition';
import type { TemplateManagementContext } from './template-management.ports';

const context: TemplateManagementContext = Object.freeze({
  mantenedoraId: 'tenant-1',
  buId: 'bu-1',
  channelId: 'channel-1',
  providerResourceIdentityId: 'identity-1',
  generation: 3,
  pairingEpoch: 5,
  activeCredentialVersion: 7,
  accountReference: 'opaque-account-ref' as never,
});

const validDefinition = {
  name: ' Bem-vindo ao LeadsHug ',
  language: 'pt_BR',
  category: 'MARKETING',
  header: 'Olá',
  body: 'Oi {{first_name}}, sua conta {{company}} está pronta.',
  footer: 'Equipe LeadsHug',
  examples: { first_name: 'Ana', company: 'Acme' },
};

describe('normalização da definição de template', () => {
  it('normaliza o nome, preserva componentes de texto e aceita variáveis nomeadas com exemplos exatos', () => {
    expect(normalizeTemplateDefinition(validDefinition)).toEqual({
      name: 'bem_vindo_ao_leadshug',
      language: 'pt_BR',
      category: 'MARKETING',
      header: 'Olá',
      body: 'Oi {{first_name}}, sua conta {{company}} está pronta.',
      footer: 'Equipe LeadsHug',
      examples: { first_name: 'Ana', company: 'Acme' },
    });
    expect(normalizeTemplateName('  Olá - Equipe  ')).toBe('ola_equipe');
  });

  it('permite repetir uma variável nomeada, contando o conjunto de nomes uma vez', () => {
    const normalized = normalizeTemplateDefinition({
      ...validDefinition,
      body: 'Oi {{first_name}}, até logo {{first_name}}.',
      examples: { first_name: 'Ana' },
    });
    expect(normalized.examples).toEqual({ first_name: 'Ana' });
  });

  it.each([
    { ...validDefinition, name: '1-invalido' },
    { ...validDefinition, name: `n${'a'.repeat(128)}` },
    { ...validDefinition, language: 'en_US' },
    { ...validDefinition, category: 'AUTHENTICATION' },
    { ...validDefinition, body: '' },
    { ...validDefinition, body: 'x'.repeat(1025), examples: {} },
    { ...validDefinition, body: '{{first_name}}, seu cadastro está pronto.' },
    { ...validDefinition, body: 'Seu cadastro está pronto {{first_name}}' },
    { ...validDefinition, body: 'Olá {first_name}, seu cadastro está pronto.' },
    { ...validDefinition, body: 'Olá {{1name}}, seu cadastro está pronto.' },
    { ...validDefinition, body: 'Olá {{first_name}}, seu cadastro está pronto.', examples: {} },
    { ...validDefinition, body: 'Olá {{first_name}}, seu cadastro está pronto.', examples: { first_name: 'Ana', extra: 'fora' } },
    { ...validDefinition, header: 'Olá {{first_name}}' },
    { ...validDefinition, footer: '{{company}}' },
    { ...validDefinition, buttons: [{ text: 'Saiba mais' }] },
    { ...validDefinition, header: 'x'.repeat(61) },
    { ...validDefinition, footer: 'x'.repeat(61) },
    { ...validDefinition, examples: { first_name: '', company: 'Acme' } },
    { ...validDefinition, examples: { first_name: 'x'.repeat(129), company: 'Acme' } },
  ])('rejeita definição fora do contrato sem incluir conteúdo em erro seguro %#', (input) => {
    try {
      normalizeTemplateDefinition(input);
      throw new Error('esperava validação da definição');
    } catch (error) {
      expect(error).toBeInstanceOf(TemplateDefinitionError);
      expect((error as Error).message).toBe('Definição de modelo inválida.');
      expect((error as Error).message).not.toContain(JSON.stringify(input));
    }
  });

  it('rejeita mais de 20 variáveis únicas e entrada acima dos limites do contrato', () => {
    const body = `Olá ${Array.from({ length: 21 }, (_, index) => `{{v_${String.fromCharCode(97 + index)}}}`).join(' ')}, tudo certo.`;
    const examples = Object.fromEntries(Array.from({ length: 21 }, (_, index) => [`v_${String.fromCharCode(97 + index)}`, 'exemplo']));
    expect(() => normalizeTemplateDefinition({ ...validDefinition, body, examples })).toThrow(TemplateDefinitionError);
    expect(() => normalizeTemplateDefinition({ ...validDefinition, body: 'x'.repeat(16_385), examples: {} })).toThrow(TemplateDefinitionError);
    expect(() => normalizeTemplateDefinition({ ...validDefinition, unsupported: 'x'.repeat(16_385) })).toThrow(TemplateDefinitionError);
  });

  it('retorna campo e razão seguros para o BFF sem incluir texto de entrada', () => {
    for (const [input, field, reason] of [
      [{ ...validDefinition, name: '1-private text' }, 'name', 'INVALID_FORMAT'],
      [{ ...validDefinition, body: '' }, 'body', 'OUT_OF_RANGE'],
      [{ ...validDefinition, body: 'Oi {{first_name}}, tudo pronto.', examples: {} }, 'examples', 'MISSING_EXAMPLE'],
      [{ ...validDefinition, header: '{{first_name}}' }, 'header', 'INVALID_FORMAT'],
    ] as const) {
      try { normalizeTemplateDefinition(input); throw new Error('expected validation error'); } catch (error) {
        expect(error).toMatchObject({ code: 'TEMPLATE_DEFINITION_INVALID', field, reason });
        expect((error as Error).message).not.toContain('private text');
      }
    }
  });

  it('applies the 16 KiB cap to an otherwise field-valid JSON definition', () => {
    const names = Array.from({ length: 20 }, (_, index) => `v_${String.fromCharCode(97 + index)}`);
    const placeholders = names.map((name) => `{{${name}}}`).join(' ');
    const body = `${placeholders}${'\u0000'.repeat(1024 - Array.from(placeholders).length)}`;
    const input = {
      name: 'valid_size_probe', language: 'pt_BR', category: 'UTILITY', body,
      examples: Object.fromEntries(names.map((name) => [name, '\u0000'.repeat(128)])),
    };
    expect(Array.from(input.body)).toHaveLength(1024);
    expect(Object.values(input.examples).every((example) => Array.from(example).length === 128)).toBe(true);
    expect(Buffer.byteLength(JSON.stringify(input), 'utf8')).toBeGreaterThan(16 * 1024);
    expect(() => normalizeTemplateDefinition(input)).toThrow(TemplateDefinitionError);
  });

  it('renderiza a prévia em texto plano e vincula fingerprint ao contexto/revisão sem marcar rascunho ausente como salvo', () => {
    const preview = createTemplatePreview(validDefinition, context);
    expect(preview.definition.name).toBe('bem_vindo_ao_leadshug');
    expect(preview.renderedText).toBe('Olá\nOi Ana, sua conta Acme está pronta.\nEquipe LeadsHug');
    expect(preview.persistence).toBe('UNPERSISTED');
    expect(preview.requestFingerprint).toMatch(/^[a-f0-9]{64}$/);

    const otherContext = Object.freeze({ ...context, generation: 4 });
    const otherPreview = createTemplatePreview(validDefinition, otherContext);
    expect(otherPreview.requestFingerprint).not.toBe(preview.requestFingerprint);

    const saved = createTemplatePreview(validDefinition, context, { draftId: 'draft-1', revision: 2 });
    expect(saved.persistence).toBe('PERSISTED');
    expect(saved.requestFingerprint).not.toBe(preview.requestFingerprint);
  });

  it('recusa referência de rascunho incompleta ou inválida', () => {
    expect(() => createTemplatePreview(validDefinition, context, { draftId: 'draft-1', revision: 0 })).toThrow(TemplateDefinitionError);
  });
});
```

## api-app/src/domain/message-templates/template-definition.ts

```text
import { createHash } from 'node:crypto';
import type {
  TemplateCategory,
  TemplateDefinition,
  TemplateManagementContext,
} from './template-management.ports';

const NAME_PATTERN = /^[a-z][a-z0-9_]{0,127}$/;
const VARIABLE_PATTERN = /^[a-z][a-z_]{0,31}$/;
const MAX_DEFINITION_BYTES = 16 * 1024;
const MAX_BODY_VARIABLES = 20;

export class TemplateDefinitionError extends Error {
  readonly code = 'TEMPLATE_DEFINITION_INVALID';

  constructor(
    readonly field: 'name' | 'language' | 'category' | 'header' | 'body' | 'footer' | 'examples' | 'definition' = 'definition',
    readonly reason: 'REQUIRED' | 'INVALID_FORMAT' | 'OUT_OF_RANGE' | 'UNSUPPORTED' | 'MISSING_EXAMPLE' | 'EXTRA_EXAMPLE' | 'TOO_LARGE' = 'INVALID_FORMAT',
  ) {
    super('Definição de modelo inválida.');
    this.name = 'TemplateDefinitionError';
  }
}

function invalid(field: TemplateDefinitionError['field'] = 'definition', reason: TemplateDefinitionError['reason'] = 'INVALID_FORMAT'): never {
  throw new TemplateDefinitionError(field, reason);
}

function isRecord(value: unknown): value is Record<string, unknown> {
  return typeof value === 'object' && value !== null && !Array.isArray(value)
    && (Object.getPrototypeOf(value) === Object.prototype || Object.getPrototypeOf(value) === null);
}

function characterCount(value: string): number {
  return Array.from(value).length;
}

export function normalizeTemplateName(input: unknown): string {
  if (typeof input !== 'string') return invalid('name', 'REQUIRED');
  const normalized = input.normalize('NFKD')
    .replace(/\p{Diacritic}/gu, '')
    .trim()
    .toLowerCase()
    .replace(/[\s-]+/g, '_')
    .replace(/^_+|_+$/g, '');
  if (!NAME_PATTERN.test(normalized)) return invalid('name', 'INVALID_FORMAT');
  return normalized;
}

function requiredText(value: unknown, min: number, max: number, field: TemplateDefinitionError['field']): string {
  if (typeof value !== 'string') return invalid(field, 'REQUIRED');
  const length = characterCount(value);
  if (length < min || length > max) return invalid(field, 'OUT_OF_RANGE');
  return value;
}

function optionalStaticText(value: unknown, field: 'header' | 'footer'): string | undefined {
  if (value === undefined) return undefined;
  const text = requiredText(value, 1, 60, field);
  if (/[{}]/.test(text)) return invalid(field, 'INVALID_FORMAT');
  return text;
}

function parseBodyVariables(body: string): string[] {
  const names: string[] = [];
  const placeholderPattern = /\{\{([^{}]*)\}\}/g;
  for (const match of body.matchAll(placeholderPattern)) {
    const name = match[1];
    if (!VARIABLE_PATTERN.test(name)) return invalid('body', 'INVALID_FORMAT');
    names.push(name);
  }
  if (/[{}]/.test(body.replace(placeholderPattern, ''))) return invalid('body', 'INVALID_FORMAT');

  const trimmedBody = body.trim();
  if (trimmedBody.startsWith('{{') || trimmedBody.endsWith('}}')) return invalid('body', 'INVALID_FORMAT');
  const uniqueNames = [...new Set(names)];
  if (uniqueNames.length > MAX_BODY_VARIABLES) return invalid('body', 'OUT_OF_RANGE');
  return uniqueNames;
}

function validateExamples(value: unknown, variableNames: readonly string[]): Readonly<Record<string, string>> {
  if (!isRecord(value)) return invalid('examples', 'REQUIRED');
  const keys = Object.keys(value).sort();
  const expected = [...variableNames].sort();
  if (keys.some((key) => !expected.includes(key))) return invalid('examples', 'EXTRA_EXAMPLE');
  if (keys.length !== expected.length || keys.some((key, index) => key !== expected[index])) return invalid('examples', 'MISSING_EXAMPLE');

  const examples: Record<string, string> = {};
  for (const key of expected) examples[key] = requiredText(value[key], 1, 128, 'examples');
  return Object.freeze(examples);
}

export function normalizeTemplateDefinition(input: unknown): TemplateDefinition {
  if (!isRecord(input)) return invalid('definition', 'REQUIRED');
  let serializedInput: string | undefined;
  try {
    serializedInput = JSON.stringify(input);
  } catch {
    return invalid('definition', 'INVALID_FORMAT');
  }
  if (!serializedInput) return invalid('definition', 'INVALID_FORMAT');
  if (Buffer.byteLength(serializedInput, 'utf8') > MAX_DEFINITION_BYTES) return invalid('definition', 'TOO_LARGE');
  const supportedKeys = new Set(['name', 'language', 'category', 'header', 'body', 'footer', 'examples']);
  if (Object.keys(input).some((key) => !supportedKeys.has(key))) return invalid('definition', 'UNSUPPORTED');

  const name = normalizeTemplateName(input.name);
  const language = input.language;
  if (language !== 'pt_BR') return invalid('language', 'INVALID_FORMAT');
  const category = input.category;
  if (category !== 'MARKETING' && category !== 'UTILITY') return invalid('category', 'INVALID_FORMAT');
  const body = requiredText(input.body, 1, 1024, 'body');
  const variableNames = parseBodyVariables(body);
  const examples = validateExamples(input.examples, variableNames);
  const header = optionalStaticText(input.header, 'header');
  const footer = optionalStaticText(input.footer, 'footer');

  const definition: TemplateDefinition = Object.freeze({
    name,
    language,
    category: category as TemplateCategory,
    ...(header === undefined ? {} : { header }),
    body,
    ...(footer === undefined ? {} : { footer }),
    examples,
  });
  if (Buffer.byteLength(JSON.stringify(definition), 'utf8') > MAX_DEFINITION_BYTES) return invalid('definition', 'TOO_LARGE');
  return definition;
}

export interface SavedTemplateRevision {
  readonly draftId: string;
  readonly revision: number;
  /** false when a preview is linked to a stored revision but contains unsaved edits. */
  readonly persisted?: boolean;
}

export interface TemplatePreview {
  readonly definition: TemplateDefinition;
  readonly renderedText: string;
  readonly requestFingerprint: string;
  readonly persistence: 'UNPERSISTED' | 'PERSISTED';
}

function validateContext(context: TemplateManagementContext): void {
  if (!context || !context.mantenedoraId || !context.buId || !context.channelId || !context.providerResourceIdentityId
    || !context.accountReference || !Number.isSafeInteger(context.generation) || context.generation < 0
    || !Number.isSafeInteger(context.pairingEpoch) || context.pairingEpoch < 0
    || (context.activeCredentialVersion !== null
      && (!Number.isSafeInteger(context.activeCredentialVersion) || context.activeCredentialVersion < 0))) {
    return invalid();
  }
}

function canonicalSemanticJson(value: unknown): string {
  if (Array.isArray(value)) return `[${value.map(canonicalSemanticJson).join(',')}]`;
  if (value && typeof value === 'object') {
    const row = value as Record<string, unknown>;
    return `{${Object.keys(row).filter((key) => key !== 'example').sort()
      .map((key) => `${JSON.stringify(key)}:${canonicalSemanticJson(row[key])}`).join(',')}}`;
  }
  return JSON.stringify(value) ?? 'null';
}

/** Fingerprint of the complete supported provider semantics, excluding only examples. */
export function templateDefinitionSemanticFingerprint(definition: TemplateDefinition): string {
  const components = [
    ...(definition.header === undefined ? [] : [{ type: 'HEADER', format: 'TEXT', text: definition.header }]),
    { type: 'BODY', text: definition.body },
    ...(definition.footer === undefined ? [] : [{ type: 'FOOTER', text: definition.footer }]),
  ];
  return createHash('sha256').update(canonicalSemanticJson({ name: definition.name,
    language: definition.language, category: definition.category, parameterFormat: 'NAMED', components })).digest('hex');
}

function validateSavedRevision(saved: SavedTemplateRevision | undefined): void {
  if (saved === undefined) return;
  if (!saved.draftId || !Number.isSafeInteger(saved.revision) || saved.revision < 1
    || (saved.persisted !== undefined && typeof saved.persisted !== 'boolean')) return invalid();
}

export function createTemplatePreview(
  input: unknown,
  context: TemplateManagementContext,
  savedRevision?: SavedTemplateRevision,
): TemplatePreview {
  validateContext(context);
  validateSavedRevision(savedRevision);
  const definition = normalizeTemplateDefinition(input);
  const renderedBody = definition.body.replace(/\{\{([a-z][a-z_]{0,31})\}\}/g, (_placeholder, name: string) => definition.examples[name]);
  const renderedText = [definition.header, renderedBody, definition.footer]
    .filter((part): part is string => part !== undefined)
    .join('\n');
  const fingerprintInput = {
    context: {
      mantenedoraId: context.mantenedoraId,
      buId: context.buId,
      channelId: context.channelId,
      providerResourceIdentityId: context.providerResourceIdentityId,
      generation: context.generation,
      pairingEpoch: context.pairingEpoch,
      activeCredentialVersion: context.activeCredentialVersion,
      accountReference: context.accountReference,
    },
    draft: savedRevision ? { draftId: savedRevision.draftId, revision: savedRevision.revision } : null,
    definition,
  };
  const requestFingerprint = createHash('sha256').update(JSON.stringify(fingerprintInput)).digest('hex');
  return Object.freeze({
    definition,
    renderedText,
    requestFingerprint,
    persistence: savedRevision?.persisted === false ? 'UNPERSISTED' : savedRevision ? 'PERSISTED' : 'UNPERSISTED',
  });
}
```
