```text
import { MiddlewareConsumer, Module, NestModule, RequestMethod } from '@nestjs/common';
import { AccessService } from '../../domain/access/access.service';
import { IdentityService } from '../../domain/identity/identity.service';
import { LoginAttemptService } from '../../domain/identity/login-attempt.service';
import { PasswordService } from '../../domain/identity/password.service';
import { SessionService } from '../../infra/session/session.service';
import { ChannelsService } from '../../domain/channels/channels.service';
import { NumberRegistrationService } from '../../domain/channels/number-registration.service';
import { NumberRegistrationsController } from './number-registrations.controller';
import { ConversationsService } from '../../domain/inbox/conversations.service';
import { HistoricoService } from '../../domain/inbox/historico.service';
import { ApiKeyService } from '../../domain/integration/api-key.service';
import { TenancyService } from '../../domain/tenancy/tenancy.service';
import { ModulosService } from '../../domain/produto/modulos.service';
import { SetorService } from '../../domain/setor/setor.service';
import { RegistroDeAtividade } from '../../domain/historico/registro.service';
import { AtividadesService } from '../../domain/historico/atividades.service';
import { OnboardingService } from '../../domain/produto/onboarding.service';
import { PainelService } from '../../domain/painel/painel.service';
import { ArmazenamentoDeArquivo, ArmazenamentoEmDisco } from '../../infra/arquivos/armazenamento';
import { EnvioDeEmail, ResendEmail } from '../../integrations/email/email.client';
import { TokensService } from '../../domain/acesso/tokens.service';
import { ConvitesService } from '../../domain/acesso/convites.service';
import { LimiteDeRecuperacao } from '../../domain/acesso/limite-de-recuperacao.service';
import { ChannelTransportModule } from '../../integrations/channels/channel-transport.module';
import { AuthController } from './auth.controller';
import { ChannelsController } from './channels.controller';
import { ConversationsController } from './conversations.controller';
import { UsuariosService } from '../../domain/identity/usuarios.service';
import { HistoricoController } from './historico.controller';
import { UsuariosController } from './usuarios.controller';
import { IntegracaoController } from './integracao.controller';
import { BusinessUnitsController, MeController } from './me.controller';
import { SetoresController } from './setores.controller';
import { AtividadesController } from './atividades.controller';
import { OnboardingController } from './onboarding.controller';
import { PainelController } from './painel.controller';
import { ArquivosController } from './arquivos.controller';
import { SessionMiddleware } from './session.middleware';
import { TYPEBOT_CLIENT, TypebotHttpClient } from '../../integrations/typebot/typebot.client';
import { TemplateManagementModule } from '../../integrations/message-templates/template-management.module';
import { TemplateDraftService } from '../../domain/message-templates/template-draft.service';
import { TemplateSubmissionService } from '../../domain/message-templates/template-submission.service';
import { PrismaTemplateTransactionBoundary, TEMPLATE_TRANSACTION_BOUNDARY } from '../../domain/message-templates/template-transaction-boundary';
import { PrismaService } from '../../infra/prisma/prisma.service';
import { MessageTemplatesController } from './message-templates.controller';
import { TEMPLATE_OBSERVATION_CLOCK, TemplateObservationService } from '../../domain/message-templates/template-observation.service';

/**
 * Superfície BFF (ADR-0006): o que as telas consomem, autenticado por sessão.
 *
 * O middleware é montado no PREFIXO. É isso que faz o guard ser da superfície e
 * não da rota, e é o que impede o defeito que já mordeu os dois sistemas: no
 * Hub, um router.use(requireAuth) sem path interceptou o webhook público.
 */
@Module({
  imports: [ChannelTransportModule, TemplateManagementModule],
  controllers: [
    AuthController,
    MeController,
    BusinessUnitsController,
    ChannelsController,
    NumberRegistrationsController,
    ConversationsController,
    IntegracaoController,
    HistoricoController,
    UsuariosController,
    SetoresController,
    AtividadesController,
    OnboardingController,
    PainelController,
    ArquivosController,
    MessageTemplatesController,
  ],
  providers: [
    SessionService,
    IdentityService,
    PasswordService,
    LoginAttemptService,
    AccessService,
    TemplateDraftService,
    TemplateSubmissionService,
    TemplateObservationService,
    { provide: TEMPLATE_OBSERVATION_CLOCK, useValue: { now: () => new Date() } },
    { provide: TEMPLATE_TRANSACTION_BOUNDARY, useFactory: (prisma: PrismaService) => new PrismaTemplateTransactionBoundary(prisma), inject: [PrismaService] },
    ChannelsService,
    NumberRegistrationService,
    ConversationsService,
    HistoricoService,
    UsuariosService,
    ApiKeyService,
    TenancyService,
    ModulosService,
    SetorService,
    RegistroDeAtividade,
    AtividadesService,
    OnboardingService,
    PainelService,
    { provide: ArmazenamentoDeArquivo, useClass: ArmazenamentoEmDisco },
    { provide: EnvioDeEmail, useClass: ResendEmail },
    TokensService,
    ConvitesService,
    LimiteDeRecuperacao,
    // Adaptadores de SAÍDA por porta (ADR-0006, Emenda 1): o domínio depende da
    // interface, não do HTTP. É o que deixa o teste provar permissão sem a Meta
    // nem a Evolution no ar.
    { provide: TYPEBOT_CLIENT, useClass: TypebotHttpClient },
  ],
  exports: [SessionService, PasswordService],
})
export class BffModule implements NestModule {
  configure(consumer: MiddlewareConsumer): void {
    consumer
      .apply(SessionMiddleware)
      .forRoutes({ path: 'api/bff/{*path}', method: RequestMethod.ALL });
  }
}
```

## api-app/src/surfaces/bff/message-templates.controller.ts

```text
import { BadRequestException, Body, Controller, Get, Headers, HttpCode, HttpStatus, Param, Patch, Post, Query, Req, Res, UnauthorizedException } from '@nestjs/common';
import type { Prisma } from '@prisma/client';
import type { Request, Response } from 'express';
import { AccessService } from '../../domain/access/access.service';
import { exigirPapelNaBu } from '../../domain/access/require-role';
import { TemplateDraftService } from '../../domain/message-templates/template-draft.service';
import { TemplateSubmissionService } from '../../domain/message-templates/template-submission.service';
import { TemplateObservationService } from '../../domain/message-templates/template-observation.service';
import { PrismaService } from '../../infra/prisma/prisma.service';
import { SessionService } from '../../infra/session/session.service';

const UUID = /^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[1-8][0-9a-f]{3}-[89ab][0-9a-f]{3}-[0-9a-f]{12}$/i;
const DEFINITION_KEYS = ['name', 'language', 'category', 'body', 'header', 'footer', 'examples'];

@Controller('api/bff')
export class MessageTemplatesController {
  constructor(
    private readonly access: AccessService,
    private readonly drafts: TemplateDraftService,
    private readonly submissions: TemplateSubmissionService,
    private readonly observations: TemplateObservationService,
    private readonly sessions: SessionService,
    private readonly prisma: PrismaService,
  ) {}

  @Get('business-units/:buId/channels/:channelId/message-template-capabilities')
  async capabilities(@Param('buId') buId: string, @Param('channelId') channelId: string, @Req() req: Request) {
    requireUuid(buId); requireUuid(channelId);
    await exigirPapelNaBu(this.access, req.usuario!.id, buId, 'ATENDENTE');
    return this.drafts.capabilities(req.usuario!.id, buId, channelId);
  }

  @Get('business-units/:buId/message-templates')
  async list(@Param('buId') buId: string, @Query() query: Record<string, string>, @Req() req: Request) {
    requireUuid(buId);
    await exigirPapelNaBu(this.access, req.usuario!.id, buId, 'ATENDENTE');
    if (Object.keys(query).some((key) => !['view', 'page', 'limit'].includes(key))) throw badRequest();
    const page = query.page === undefined ? undefined : Number(query.page);
    const limit = query.limit === undefined ? undefined : Number(query.limit);
    if ((page !== undefined && (!Number.isSafeInteger(page) || page < 1))
      || (limit !== undefined && (!Number.isSafeInteger(limit) || limit < 1 || limit > 50))) throw badRequest();
    if (query.view !== undefined && query.view !== 'mine' && query.view !== 'bu') throw badRequest();
    return this.drafts.listDrafts(req.usuario!.id, buId, { view: query.view as 'mine' | 'bu' | undefined, page, limit });
  }

  @Post('business-units/:buId/message-templates/preview')
  @HttpCode(HttpStatus.OK)
  async preview(@Param('buId') buId: string, @Body() body: Record<string, unknown>, @Req() req: Request) {
    requireUuid(buId);
    await exigirPapelNaBu(this.access, req.usuario!.id, buId, 'ATENDENTE');
    strictKeys(body, ['channelId', 'expectedGeneration', 'draftId', 'expectedRevision', 'definition']);
    if (typeof body.channelId !== 'string' || typeof body.expectedGeneration !== 'number'
      || !Number.isSafeInteger(body.expectedGeneration) || body.expectedGeneration < 1 || !('definition' in body)) throw badRequest();
    requireUuid(body.channelId);
    return this.drafts.preview(req.usuario!.id, {
      buId, channelId: body.channelId, expectedGeneration: body.expectedGeneration,
      ...(body.draftId === undefined ? {} : { draftId: stringField(body.draftId) }),
      ...(body.expectedRevision === undefined ? {} : { expectedRevision: numberField(body.expectedRevision) }),
      definition: body.definition,
    });
  }

  @Post('business-units/:buId/message-templates')
  async create(@Param('buId') buId: string, @Body() body: Record<string, unknown>, @Req() req: Request, @Res({ passthrough: true }) res: Response) {
    requireUuid(buId);
    await exigirPapelNaBu(this.access, req.usuario!.id, buId, 'ATENDENTE');
    strictKeys(body, ['clientRequestId', 'channelId', 'expectedGeneration', ...DEFINITION_KEYS]);
    if (!UUID.test(stringField(body.clientRequestId)) || typeof body.channelId !== 'string'
      || typeof body.expectedGeneration !== 'number' || !Number.isSafeInteger(body.expectedGeneration) || body.expectedGeneration < 1) throw badRequest();
    requireUuid(body.channelId);
    const result = await this.drafts.createDraft(req.usuario!.id, {
      buId, clientRequestId: body.clientRequestId as string, channelId: body.channelId,
      expectedGeneration: body.expectedGeneration as number, definition: definitionFrom(body),
    });
    if ('replayed' in result && result.replayed) res.status(HttpStatus.OK);
    return result;
  }

  @Get('message-templates/:id')
  get(@Param('id') id: string, @Req() req: Request) { requireUuid(id); return this.drafts.getDraftById(req.usuario!.id, id); }

  @Patch('message-templates/:id')
  async save(@Param('id') id: string, @Body() body: Record<string, unknown>, @Req() req: Request) {
    requireUuid(id);
    strictKeys(body, ['expectedRevision', 'definition']);
    if (!('definition' in body)) throw badRequest();
    return this.drafts.saveDraftById(req.usuario!.id, id, numberField(body.expectedRevision), body.definition);
  }

  @Post('message-templates/:id/submit')
  @HttpCode(HttpStatus.CREATED)
  async submit(@Param('id') id: string, @Headers('idempotency-key') key: string, @Body() body: Record<string, unknown>, @Req() req: Request, @Res({ passthrough: true }) res: Response) {
    requireUuid(id);
    strictKeys(body, ['expectedRevision', 'expectedGeneration', 'expectedDefinitionFingerprint']);
    if (!UUID.test(key ?? '') || typeof body.expectedDefinitionFingerprint !== 'string' || !/^[a-f0-9]{64}$/i.test(body.expectedDefinitionFingerprint)) throw badRequest();
    const result = await this.submissions.submitDraft(req.usuario!.id, {
      draftId: id, expectedRevision: numberField(body.expectedRevision),
      expectedGeneration: numberField(body.expectedGeneration),
      expectedDefinitionFingerprint: body.expectedDefinitionFingerprint as string, idempotencyKey: key,
    }, this.authRevalidation(req));
    if (result.phase === 'PREPARED' || result.phase === 'SENDING' || ('recoveryInProgress' in result && result.recoveryInProgress === true)) res.status(HttpStatus.ACCEPTED);
    else if ('replayed' in result && result.replayed === true) res.status(HttpStatus.OK);
    return result;
  }

  @Get('message-templates/:id/operations/:operationId')
  operation(@Param('id') id: string, @Param('operationId') operationId: string, @Req() req: Request) {
    requireUuid(id); requireUuid(operationId);
    return this.submissions.getOperation(req.usuario!.id, id, operationId);
  }

  @Post('message-templates/:id/operations/:operationId/reconcile')
  @HttpCode(HttpStatus.OK)
  async reconcile(@Param('id') id: string, @Param('operationId') operationId: string, @Body() body: Record<string, unknown>, @Req() req: Request, @Res({ passthrough: true }) res: Response) {
    requireUuid(id); requireUuid(operationId);
    strictKeys(body ?? {}, []);
    const result = await this.submissions.reconcile(req.usuario!.id, id, operationId, this.authRevalidation(req));
    if ('recoveryInProgress' in result && result.recoveryInProgress === true) res.status(HttpStatus.ACCEPTED);
    return result;
  }

  @Post('message-templates/:id/refresh')
  @HttpCode(HttpStatus.OK)
  async refreshDraft(@Param('id') id: string, @Body() body: Record<string, unknown>, @Req() req: Request, @Res({ passthrough: true }) res: Response) {
    requireUuid(id);
    strictKeys(body ?? {}, []);
    const result = await this.observations.refreshDraft(req.usuario!.id, id, this.authRevalidation(req));
    if ('phase' in result && result.phase === 'REFRESH_IN_PROGRESS') res.status(HttpStatus.ACCEPTED);
    return result;
  }

  @Get('business-units/:buId/channels/:channelId/message-template-catalog')
  async getCatalog(@Param('buId') buId: string, @Param('channelId') channelId: string, @Query() query: Record<string, string>, @Req() req: Request) {
    requireUuid(buId); requireUuid(channelId);
    if (Object.keys(query).some((key) => key !== 'after') || (query.after !== undefined && (typeof query.after !== 'string' || query.after.length < 1 || query.after.length > 512))) throw badRequest();
    return this.observations.getCatalog(req.usuario!.id, buId, channelId, query.after ?? null);
  }

  @Post('business-units/:buId/channels/:channelId/message-template-catalog')
  @HttpCode(HttpStatus.OK)
  async refreshCatalog(@Param('buId') buId: string, @Param('channelId') channelId: string, @Body() body: Record<string, unknown>, @Req() req: Request, @Res({ passthrough: true }) res: Response) {
    requireUuid(buId); requireUuid(channelId);
    strictKeys(body ?? {}, ['after']);
    const after = body?.after === undefined ? null : stringField(body.after);
    if (after !== null && (after.length < 1 || after.length > 512)) throw badRequest();
    const result = await this.observations.refreshCatalog(req.usuario!.id, buId, channelId, after, this.authRevalidation(req));
    if ('phase' in result && result.phase === 'REFRESH_IN_PROGRESS') res.status(HttpStatus.ACCEPTED);
    return result;
  }

  private authRevalidation(req: Request): (tx?: Prisma.TransactionClient) => Promise<void> {
    const claimsAtRequest = this.sessions.verificar(this.sessions.extrairDoCabecalho(req.headers.cookie));
    if (!claimsAtRequest || claimsAtRequest.uid !== req.usuario!.id) throw new UnauthorizedException({ code: 'NAO_AUTENTICADO' });
    return async (tx) => {
      const claims = this.sessions.verificar(this.sessions.extrairDoCabecalho(req.headers.cookie));
      let user: { id: string; status: string; passwordChangedAt: Date | null } | null = null;
      if (claims && claims.uid === claimsAtRequest.uid) {
        if (tx) {
          const rows = await tx.$queryRaw<Array<{ id: string; status: string; passwordChangedAt: Date | null }>>`
            SELECT id, status::text AS status, password_changed_at AS "passwordChangedAt"
            FROM app_users WHERE id = ${claims.uid} FOR UPDATE`;
          user = rows[0] ?? null;
        } else {
          user = await this.prisma.appUser.findUnique({ where: { id: claims.uid }, select: { id: true, status: true, passwordChangedAt: true } });
        }
      }
      if (!claims || claims.uid !== claimsAtRequest.uid || claims.iat !== claimsAtRequest.iat || claims.exp !== claimsAtRequest.exp
        || !user || user.status !== 'ATIVO' || (user.passwordChangedAt && user.passwordChangedAt.getTime() > claims.iat)) {
        throw new UnauthorizedException({ code: 'NAO_AUTENTICADO' });
      }
    };
  }
}

function strictKeys(value: unknown, allowed: readonly string[]): asserts value is Record<string, unknown> {
  if (!value || typeof value !== 'object' || Array.isArray(value)
    || Object.keys(value).some((key) => !allowed.includes(key))) throw badRequest();
}
function requireUuid(value: unknown): asserts value is string { if (typeof value !== 'string' || !UUID.test(value)) throw badRequest(); }
function stringField(value: unknown): string { if (typeof value !== 'string') throw badRequest(); return value; }
function numberField(value: unknown): number { if (typeof value !== 'number' || !Number.isSafeInteger(value) || value < 1) throw badRequest(); return value; }
function definitionFrom(body: Record<string, unknown>): Record<string, unknown> {
  const definition: Record<string, unknown> = {};
  for (const key of DEFINITION_KEYS) if (key in body) definition[key] = body[key];
  return definition;
}
function badRequest(): BadRequestException { return new BadRequestException({ code: 'TEMPLATE_PAYLOAD_INVALID' }); }
```

```text
const { Test } = require('@nestjs/testing');
const { AppModule } = require('../dist/app.module.js');
const { META_CLIENT, MetaIndisponivelError } = require('../dist/integrations/meta/meta.client.js');
const { EVOLUTION_CLIENT } = require('../dist/integrations/evolution/evolution.client.js');
const { configurarBodyParsers } = require('../dist/infra/http/body-parsers.js');
const { RealtimeService } = require('../dist/realtime/realtime.service.js');
const { sealChannelCredential } = require('../dist/domain/channels/channel-credential-crypto.js');
const { PrismaService } = require('../dist/infra/prisma/prisma.service.js');

async function main() {
  const fixturePort = Number(process.env.LEADSHUG_FIXTURE_PORT ?? '3101');
const db = process.env.DATABASE_URL;
  const fixtureDb = process.env.LEADSHUG_E2E_DATABASE_URL;
  if (!db || db !== fixtureDb) throw new Error('O servidor de browser requer DATABASE_URL igual ao banco dedicado de E2E.');
  const dbName = new URL(db).pathname.slice(1).split('?')[0];
  if (!dbName.startsWith('leadshug_timeline_')) throw new Error('O servidor de browser aceita apenas banco leadshug_timeline_* descartável.');
  process.env.SESSION_SECRET = 'segredo-de-e2e';
  process.env.INTERNAL_SERVICE_TOKEN = 'token-de-e2e';
  process.env.META_APP_SECRET = 'segredo-do-app-meta';
  process.env.META_APP_ID = 'fixture-app';
  process.env.META_SIGNUP_CONFIG_ID = 'fixture-config';
  process.env.GRAPH_VERSION = 'v26.0';
  process.env.EVOLUTION_API_URL = 'http://127.0.0.1:3101/provider/evolution';
  process.env.EVOLUTION_API_KEY = 'timeline-provider-port-only';
  process.env.EVOLUTION_WEBHOOK_SECRET = 'timeline-evolution-header-secret';
  process.env.EVOLUTION_WEBHOOK_URL = 'http://127.0.0.1:3100/webhooks/evolution';
  process.env.CHANNEL_CREDENTIAL_KEY_ID = 'timeline-key-v1';
  process.env.CHANNEL_CREDENTIAL_KEY = Buffer.alloc(32, 29).toString('base64');
  process.env.WEBHOOK_VERIFY_TOKEN = 'verify-token-de-teste';
  process.env.LH_ARQUIVOS_DIR = '/tmp/leadshug-arquivos-e2e';
  process.env.WEB_ORIGIN = 'http://127.0.0.1:4173';

  let fixturePrisma;
  const fixture = async (path, method = 'GET', body) => {
    const response = await fetch(`http://127.0.0.1:${fixturePort}${path}`, {
      method, headers: { 'x-fixture-provider-token': 'timeline-provider-port-only', ...(body ? { 'content-type': 'application/json' } : {}) },
      body: body ? JSON.stringify(body) : undefined,
    });
    if (!response.ok) throw new Error('provider fixture unavailable');
    return response.status === 204 ? null : response.json();
  };
  const nativeFetch = global.fetch.bind(global);
  global.fetch = async (input, init = {}) => {
    const url = String(input);
    if (!url.startsWith('https://graph.facebook.com/')) return nativeFetch(input, init);

    canSendText: () => true,

''); const state = await fixture('/provider/state'); if (!Object.hasOwn(state.meta.grantResourceIds ?? {}, safeCode)) throw new Error('unknown fixture authorization grant'); return { accessToken: `timeline-code-token:${Buffer.from(safeCode).toString('base64url')}` }; },
    async recursos(accessToken, wabaId, after) {

      if (!wabaId) return { wabas, numbers: [], next: null };

      if (page) data = data.filter((r) => (page.ids ?? []).includes(r.id));

    async inscreverWaba(id, accessToken) { if (!(await tokenPermitido(accessToken))) throw new Error('scoped credential required'); await call('meta.subscribe', { wabaId: id }); await fixture('/provider/effect', 'POST', { operation: 'meta.subscribe', args: { wabaId: id } }); },

  const evolutionFake = {

    async estadoDaInstancia(name) { const observed = await fixture('/provider/evolution/observe', 'POST', { name }); return observed?.connectionStatus ?? 'close'; },
    async consultarInstancia(name) { return fixture('/provider/evolution/observe', 'POST', { name }); },
    async apagarInstancia(name) { await fixture('/provider/evolution/delete', 'POST', { name }); evolutionInventory.delete(name); },
    async enviarTexto(name, contact, text) {

      const state = await fixture('/provider/state'); await call('evolution.send', { name });
      evolutionFake.enviados.push(text); const id = `timeline-evo-${evolutionFake.enviados.length}`;
      if (state.evolution.echoInsideSend === true) {
        const payload = { event: 'messages.upsert', instance: name, data: { key: { remoteJid: `${contact}@s.whatsapp.net`, fromMe: true, id }, pushName: 'Fixture', message: { conversation: text } } };
        const response = await fetch(`http://127.0.0.1:${process.env.PORT ?? '3100'}/webhooks/evolution`, { method: 'POST', headers: { 'content-type': 'application/json', 'x-leadshug-webhook-secret': process.env.EVOLUTION_WEBHOOK_SECRET }, body: JSON.stringify(payload) });
        if (!response.ok) throw new Error('authenticated fixture webhook rejected');
      }
      return { outcome: 'ACCEPTED', externalMessageId: id };
    },
    enviados: [],
  };
  const moduleRef = await Test.createTestingModule({ imports: [AppModule] })
    .overrideProvider(META_CLIENT).useValue(metaFake)
    .overrideProvider(EVOLUTION_CLIENT).useValue(evolutionFake)
    .compile();
  fixturePrisma = moduleRef.get(PrismaService);
  const app = moduleRef.createNestApplication({ bodyParser: false });
  configurarBodyParsers(app);
  app.enableCors({ origin: ['http://127.0.0.1:4173'], credentials: true });
  await app.init();
  app.get(RealtimeService).ligar(app.getHttpServer());
  await app.listen(Number(process.env.PORT ?? '3100'), '0.0.0.0');
  const close = async () => { await app.get(PrismaService).$disconnect(); await app.close(); };
  process.on('SIGTERM', () => void close().finally(() => process.exit(0)));
  process.on('SIGINT', () => void close().finally(() => process.exit(0)));
  console.log(`timeline test API listening on ${process.env.PORT ?? '3100'}; database ${dbName}`);
}

main().catch((error) => { console.error(error); process.exit(1); });
```

```text
/** Limpa na ordem das dependências — o banco de teste é real (ADR-0012 §4). */
/** Cria um usuário com papel escolhido numa BU — para o caso "papel insuficiente". */
export async function criarUsuario(
  prisma: PrismaService,
  mantenedoraId: string,
  buId: string,
  email: string,
  role: 'OWNER' | 'ADMIN' | 'ATENDENTE',
  senha = 'senha-de-teste-1',
): Promise<string> {
  const bcrypt = await import('bcryptjs');
  const user = await prisma.appUser.create({
    data: {
      mantenedoraId,
      name: email,
      email,
      passwordHash: await bcrypt.default.hash(senha, 10),
    },
  });
  await prisma.userBuRole.create({ data: { userId: user.id, buId, role, grantedViaTipo: 'DIRETO' } });
  return user.id;
}

  evolutionFake.inventory.clear();

  metaFake.enviados.length = 0; metaFake.sendIdNull = false; metaFake.sendHook = null; evolutionFake.enviados.length = 0; evolutionFake.sendIdNull = false; evolutionFake.sendHook = null; metaFake.confirmCalls = 0; metaFake.exchangeCalls = 0; metaFake.exchangeFails = 0; metaFake.providerCalls = 0;

  typebotFake.enabled = false; typebotFake.starts = 0; typebotFake.continues = 0; typebotFake.startedBots.length = 0; typebotFake.beforeReply = null;
  evolutionFake.ownerPhone = '5584999990000'; evolutionFake.createdState = 'open'; evolutionFake.deleteFails = false;
  await prisma.$executeRawUnsafe(`TRUNCATE TABLE
    "message_template_remote_observations", "message_template_catalog_pages",
    "message_template_observation_leases",

  await prisma.channelRegistrationAttempt.deleteMany();
  await prisma.channelCredential.deleteMany();
  await prisma.conversation.deleteMany();

/** Test channel fixture with the same durable ownership and credential invariants as production. */
export async function criarCanalVerificado(
  prisma: PrismaService,
  buId: string,
  type: 'OFICIAL' | 'NAO_OFICIAL',
  externalResourceId: string,
  options: { status?: 'CONECTADO' | 'CONECTANDO' | 'DESCONECTADO'; requiresWindow?: boolean } = {},
) {
  const channel = await prisma.buChannel.create({ data: {
    buId, type, status: options.status ?? 'CONECTADO', requiresWindow: options.requiresWindow ?? type === 'OFICIAL',
    ...(type === 'OFICIAL' ? { phoneNumberId: externalResourceId } : { evolutionInstanceName: externalResourceId }),
    ownNumberVerified: true, verifiedEpoch: 0, providerConnectionState: type === 'OFICIAL' ? 'SUBSCRIBED' : 'CONNECTED',
    receiptVerifiedAt: new Date(),
  } });
  const priorIdentity = await prisma.providerResourceIdentity.findUnique({
    where: { provider_externalResourceId: { provider: type, externalResourceId } },
  });
  if (priorIdentity && (priorIdentity.buId !== buId || priorIdentity.currentChannelId)) {
    throw new Error('Fixture resource identity is owned or active elsewhere.');
  }
  const identity = priorIdentity
    ? await prisma.providerResourceIdentity.update({ where: { id: priorIdentity.id }, data: { currentChannelId: channel.id, retiredAt: null, managedLifecycle: true, cleanupState: 'ACTIVE' } })
    : await prisma.providerResourceIdentity.create({ data: {
      provider: type, externalResourceId, buId, currentChannelId: channel.id, managedLifecycle: true, cleanupState: 'ACTIVE',
    } });
  if (type === 'OFICIAL') {
    const keyId = process.env.CHANNEL_CREDENTIAL_KEY_ID!;
    const key = Buffer.from(process.env.CHANNEL_CREDENTIAL_KEY!, 'base64');
    const envelope = sealChannelCredential('fixture-scoped-token', keyId, key, {
      purpose: 'active', provider: type, buId, channelId: channel.id, generation: channel.generation, version: 1,
    });
    await prisma.channelCredential.create({ data: {
      channelId: channel.id, provider: type, buId, generation: channel.generation, version: 1,
      keyId, nonce: new Uint8Array(envelope.nonce), ciphertext: new Uint8Array(envelope.ciphertext), tag: new Uint8Array(envelope.tag),
    } });
  }
  return { channel, identity };
}

/** Cria uma Mantenedora pela superfície interna — o caminho real de bootstrap. */
/**
 * Cria a Mantenedora **com o onboarding já concluído**.
 *
 * O bootstrap a cria PENDENTE (ADR-0016 §4), e é assim em produção. Os testes
 * que exercitam o produto vêm depois do wizard; quem exercita o portão é
 * `onboarding.e2e-spec.ts`, que usa `criarMantenedoraPendente`.
 */
export async function criarMantenedora(
  app: INestApplication,
  nome: string,
  email: string,
  senha = 'senha-de-teste-1',
) {
  const r = await criarMantenedoraPendente(app, nome, email, senha);
  const prisma = app.get(PrismaService);
  await prisma.mantenedoraSettings.update({
    where: { mantenedoraId: r.mantenedora.id },
    data: { onboardingConcluido: true },
  });
  return r;
}

export async function criarMantenedoraPendente(
  app: INestApplication,
  nome: string,
  email: string,
  senha = 'senha-de-teste-1',
) {
  const res = await request(app.getHttpServer())
    .post('/api/internal/mantenedoras')
    .set('x-internal-token', TOKEN_INTERNO)
    .set('x-requested-with', 'teste')
    .send({ nome, bu: { nome: `Número da ${nome}`, telefone: '5584999990000' }, owner: { nome: 'Dono', email, senha } })
    .expect(201);
  return res.body as {
    mantenedora: { id: string; nome: string };
    businessUnit: { id: string; nome: string };
    owner: { id: string; email: string };
  };
}

/** Faz login e devolve o cookie de sessão para reusar nas próximas chamadas. */
export async function login(app: INestApplication, email: string, senha = 'senha-de-teste-1'): Promise<string> {
  const res = await request(app.getHttpServer())
    .post('/api/bff/auth/login')
    .set('x-requested-with', 'teste')
    .send({ email, senha })
    .expect(200);
  const setCookie = res.headers['set-cookie'] as unknown as string[];
  return setCookie[0].split(';')[0];
}
```

```text
import { INestApplication } from '@nestjs/common';
import request from 'supertest';
import { afterAll, beforeAll, beforeEach, describe, expect, it, vi } from 'vitest';
import { PrismaService } from '../src/infra/prisma/prisma.service';
import { TemplateDraftService } from '../src/domain/message-templates/template-draft.service';
import { TemplateSubmissionService } from '../src/domain/message-templates/template-submission.service';
import { TEMPLATE_TRANSACTION_BOUNDARY, type TemplateTransactionBoundary } from '../src/domain/message-templates/template-transaction-boundary';
import { criarCanalVerificado, criarMantenedora, criarUsuario, limparBanco, login, subirApp } from './helpers';

function providerResponse(status: number, payload: unknown): Response {
  return new Response(JSON.stringify(payload), { status, headers: { 'content-type': 'application/json' } });
}

describe('BFF de message templates (PostgreSQL)', () => {
  let app: INestApplication;
  let prisma: PrismaService;
  let buId: string;
  let mantenedoraId: string;
  let cookie: string;
  let ownerId: string;

  beforeAll(async () => {
    ({ app, prisma } = await subirApp());
    await app.listen(0, '127.0.0.1');
  });
  beforeEach(async () => {
    await limparBanco(prisma);
    const tenant = await criarMantenedora(app, 'Template BFF tenant', `template-bff-${Date.now()}@example.test`);
    buId = tenant.businessUnit.id;
    mantenedoraId = tenant.mantenedora.id;
    ownerId = tenant.owner.id;
    await prisma.mantenedoraSettings.update({ where: { mantenedoraId: tenant.mantenedora.id }, data: { onboardingConcluido: true } });
    cookie = await login(app, tenant.owner.email);
  });
  afterAll(async () => { if (prisma) await limparBanco(prisma); await app?.close(); });

  it('requires the BFF session and CSRF header for state-changing template calls', async () => {
    await request(app.getHttpServer()).get('/api/bff/message-templates/not-a-draft').expect(401);
    await request(app.getHttpServer()).get('/api/bff/message-templates/not-a-draft').set('Cookie', cookie).expect(400);
    await request(app.getHttpServer()).post(`/api/bff/business-units/${buId}/message-templates`)
      .set('Cookie', cookie).send({}).expect(403);
  });

  it('scopes a real draft read to its tenant session and returns the same 404 for a foreign owner', async () => {
    const createdChannel = await criarCanalVerificado(prisma, buId, 'OFICIAL', `template-bff-scope-${Date.now()}`);
    await prisma.buChannel.update({ where: { id: createdChannel.channel.id }, data: { wabaId: 'waba-a' } });
    const draft = await app.get(TemplateDraftService).createDraft(ownerId, { buId, channelId: createdChannel.channel.id, expectedGeneration: createdChannel.channel.generation,
      clientRequestId: 'foreign-bff-scope', definition: { name: 'foreign_bff_scope', language: 'pt_BR',
        category: 'UTILITY', body: 'Olá {{first_name}}.', examples: { first_name: 'Ana' } } });
    const foreign = await criarMantenedora(app, 'Foreign BFF tenant', `template-bff-foreign-${Date.now()}@example.test`);
    await prisma.mantenedoraSettings.update({ where: { mantenedoraId: foreign.mantenedora.id }, data: { onboardingConcluido: true } });
    const foreignCookie = await login(app, foreign.owner.email);
    await request(app.getHttpServer()).get(`/api/bff/message-templates/${draft.id}`).set('Cookie', cookie).expect(200);
    await request(app.getHttpServer()).get(`/api/bff/message-templates/${draft.id}`).set('Cookie', foreignCookie).expect(404);
  });

  it('records the bounded RLS mixed-read and dispatch stage across five isolated tenants', async () => {
    const server = app.getHttpServer();
    expect(server.listening).toBe(true);
    expect(server.address()).toMatchObject({ address: '127.0.0.1', family: 'IPv4' });
    const drafts = app.get(TemplateDraftService);
    const clients: Array<{ actorId: string; buId: string; draftId: string; cookie: string; fingerprint: string; generation: number }> = [];
    const targets: string[] = [];
    for (let index = 0; index < 5; index += 1) {
      const tenant = await criarMantenedora(app, `Template RLS ${index}`, `template-rls-${Date.now()}-${index}@example.test`);
      await prisma.mantenedoraSettings.update({ where: { mantenedoraId: tenant.mantenedora.id }, data: { onboardingConcluido: true } });
      const createdChannel = await criarCanalVerificado(prisma, tenant.businessUnit.id, 'OFICIAL', `template-rls-${Date.now()}-${index}`);
      const target = `waba-rls-${index}`; targets.push(target);
      await prisma.buChannel.update({ where: { id: createdChannel.channel.id }, data: { wabaId: target } });
      const draft = await drafts.createDraft(tenant.owner.id, { buId: tenant.businessUnit.id,
        channelId: createdChannel.channel.id, expectedGeneration: createdChannel.channel.generation,
        clientRequestId: `template-rls-${index}`, definition: { name: `template_rls_${index}`, language: 'pt_BR',
          category: 'UTILITY', body: 'Olá {{first_name}}.', examples: { first_name: 'Ana' } } });
      clients.push({ actorId: tenant.owner.id, buId: tenant.businessUnit.id, draftId: draft.id, cookie: await login(app, tenant.owner.email),
        fingerprint: draft.definitionFingerprint, generation: createdChannel.channel.generation });
    }
    let grants = 0; let preflightGets = 0; let createPosts = 0;
    const fetchMock = vi.fn(async (input: RequestInfo | URL, init: RequestInit = {}) => {
      const url = String(input); const method = init.method ?? 'GET';
      if (url.includes('/debug_token') && method === 'GET') {
        grants += 1;
        return providerResponse(200, { data: { app_id: 'fixture-app', is_valid: true,
          scopes: ['whatsapp_business_management'], granular_scopes: [{ scope: 'whatsapp_business_management', target_ids: targets }] } });
      }
      if (url.includes('/message_templates?') && method === 'GET') { preflightGets += 1; return providerResponse(200, { data: [] }); }
      if (url.endsWith('/message_templates') && method === 'POST') { createPosts += 1; return providerResponse(200, { id: `rls-remote-${createPosts}` }); }
      throw new Error(`unexpected RLS stage request ${method} ${url}`);
    });
    vi.stubGlobal('fetch', fetchMock);
    const startedAt = performance.now();
    try {
      const stageResults = await Promise.allSettled(clients.map(async (client, index) => {
        const foreign = clients[(index + 1) % clients.length];
        let phase = 'own-draft-read';
        try {
          const ownRead = await request(app.getHttpServer()).get(`/api/bff/message-templates/${client.draftId}`)
            .set('Cookie', client.cookie).expect(200);
          phase = 'foreign-draft-read';
          const foreignRead = await request(app.getHttpServer()).get(`/api/bff/message-templates/${foreign.draftId}`)
            .set('Cookie', client.cookie).expect(404);
          phase = 'dispatch';
          const dispatch = await request(app.getHttpServer()).post(`/api/bff/message-templates/${client.draftId}/submit`)
            .set('Cookie', client.cookie).set('x-requested-with', 'teste')
            .set('idempotency-key', `f3100000-0000-4000-8000-${String(index + 1).padStart(12, '0')}`)
            .send({ expectedRevision: 1, expectedGeneration: client.generation,
              expectedDefinitionFingerprint: client.fingerprint }).expect(201);
          return { ownStatus: ownRead.status, foreignStatus: foreignRead.status, ownId: ownRead.body.id,
            foreignId: foreignRead.body.id, operationId: dispatch.body.id, draftId: client.draftId,
            actorId: client.actorId, buId: client.buId, phase: dispatch.body.phase };
        } catch (error) {
          const assertion = error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error);
          const statusMatch = assertion.match(/expected\s+(\d+)\b[\s\S]*?got\s+(\d+)\b/i);
          const errorName = error instanceof Error ? error.name : 'NonError';
          const errorCode = error && typeof error === 'object' && 'code' in error
            && typeof error.code === 'string' ? error.code : 'none';
          throw new Error(`RLS client=${index} phase=${phase} error=${errorName} code=${errorCode}`
            + ` expectedHttp=${statusMatch?.[1] ?? 'unknown'} actualHttp=${statusMatch?.[2] ?? 'unknown'}`, { cause: error });
        }
      }));
      const rejected = stageResults.filter((result) => result.status === 'rejected');
      if (rejected.length) throw new AggregateError(rejected.map((result) => result.status === 'rejected' ? result.reason : null),
        `RLS five-client stage had ${rejected.length} rejection(s): ${rejected.slice(0, 5).map((result) =>
          result.status === 'rejected' && result.reason instanceof Error ? result.reason.message : 'unknown failure').join('; ')}`);
      const results = stageResults.map((result) => {
        if (result.status === 'rejected') throw result.reason;
        return result.value;
      });
      const persisted = await prisma.messageTemplateOperation.findMany({ where: { id: { in: results.map((item) => item.operationId) } },
        select: { id: true, draftId: true, buId: true, actorUserId: true, phase: true } });
      const elapsedMs = Number((performance.now() - startedAt).toFixed(2));
      const evidence = { evidenceType: 'disposable-postgresql-template-rls-mixed-stage',
        stageProfile: 'RLS-SP-TEMPLATE-MIX-5', actors: clients.length, concurrentGroups: clients.length,
        thresholds: { ownDraftReadStatus: 200, foreignTenantReadStatus: 404, dispatches: 5, createPosts: 5 },
        observed: { ownReads: results.filter((item) => item.ownStatus === 200).length,
          foreign404: results.filter((item) => item.foreignStatus === 404).length,
          acceptedDispatches: results.filter((item) => item.phase === 'ACCEPTED').length,
          grants, preflightGets, createPosts, elapsedMs },
        ownership: results.map(({ operationId, draftId, actorId, buId, phase }) => ({ operationId, draftId, actorId, buId, phase })),
        metricsComparison: { expectedPosts: 5, observedPosts: createPosts, unexpectedPosts: Math.max(0, createPosts - 5),
          endpointGroups: 'each independent owner performed one own read, one foreign read, and one submission' },
        limits: 'Bounded five-tenant disposable PostgreSQL stage; no production capacity or latency threshold.' };
      console.log(`[TEMPLATE-RLS-EVIDENCE]${JSON.stringify(evidence)}`);
      expect(results.map((item) => item.ownId)).toEqual(clients.map((item) => item.draftId));
      expect(results.every((item) => item.foreignId === undefined)).toBe(true);
      expect(results.every((item) => item.phase === 'ACCEPTED')).toBe(true);
      expect({ grants, preflightGets, createPosts }).toEqual({ grants: 5, preflightGets: 5, createPosts: 5 });
      expect(new Set(results.map((item) => item.operationId)).size).toBe(5);
      expect(persisted).toHaveLength(5);
      for (const result of results) expect(persisted).toContainEqual({ id: result.operationId, draftId: result.draftId,
        buId: result.buId, actorUserId: result.actorId, phase: 'ACCEPTED' });
    } finally { vi.unstubAllGlobals(); }
  }, 30_000);

  it('preserves the known reservation and refusal when the final operation projection fails', async () => {
    const createdChannel = await criarCanalVerificado(prisma, buId, 'OFICIAL', `template-bff-projection-${Date.now()}`);
    await prisma.buChannel.update({ where: { id: createdChannel.channel.id }, data: { wabaId: 'waba-a' } });
    const fetchMock = vi.fn(async (input: RequestInfo | URL, init: RequestInit = {}) => {
      const url = String(input); const method = init.method ?? 'GET';
      if (url.includes('/debug_token')) return providerResponse(200, { data: { app_id: 'fixture-app', is_valid: true,
        scopes: ['whatsapp_business_management'], granular_scopes: [{ scope: 'whatsapp_business_management', target_ids: ['waba-a'] }] } });
      if (url.includes('/message_templates?') && method === 'GET') return providerResponse(200, { data: [] });
      if (url.endsWith('/message_templates') && method === 'POST') return providerResponse(400, { error: {
        code: 100, type: 'OAuthException', message: 'Fixture template was rejected',
      } });
      throw new Error(`unexpected template request ${method} ${url}`);
    });
    vi.stubGlobal('fetch', fetchMock);
    const boundary = app.get<TemplateTransactionBoundary>(TEMPLATE_TRANSACTION_BOUNDARY);
    const originalRun = boundary.run.bind(boundary);
    const submission = app.get(TemplateSubmissionService) as unknown as { prisma: PrismaService };
    const originalPrisma = submission.prisma;
    let projectionMode: 'reserve-readback-then-fail' | 'release-projection-fail' | null = null;
    let operationReads = 0;
    let projectionFailureArmed = false;
    submission.prisma = new Proxy(originalPrisma, { get(prismaValue, property) {
      const delegate = Reflect.get(prismaValue, property, prismaValue);
      if (property !== 'messageTemplateOperation' || !delegate || typeof delegate !== 'object') return delegate;
      return new Proxy(delegate as object, { get(modelDelegate, method) {
        const value = Reflect.get(modelDelegate, method, modelDelegate);
        if (method === 'findFirst' && projectionMode && projectionFailureArmed) return (...args: unknown[]) => {
          operationReads += 1;
          const shouldFail = projectionMode === 'reserve-readback-then-fail' ? operationReads === 2 : operationReads === 1;
          if (shouldFail) { projectionFailureArmed = false; return Promise.reject(new Error('injected final projection unavailable')); }
          return (value as (...input: unknown[]) => unknown).apply(modelDelegate, args);
        };
        return value;
      } });
    } });
    const definition = { name: 'projection_reserve', language: 'pt_BR', category: 'UTILITY',
      body: 'Olá {{first_name}}.', examples: { first_name: 'Ana' } };
    try {
      const prepared = await app.get(TemplateDraftService).createDraft(ownerId, { buId, channelId: createdChannel.channel.id,
        expectedGeneration: createdChannel.channel.generation, clientRequestId: 'projection-reserve', definition });
      vi.spyOn(boundary, 'run').mockImplementation(async (phase, work) => {
        const result = await originalRun(phase, work);
        if (phase === 'reserve' && projectionMode === 'reserve-readback-then-fail') {
          projectionFailureArmed = true;
          throw new Error('injected reserve post-commit boundary loss');
        }
        if (phase === 'release' && projectionMode === 'release-projection-fail') {
          operationReads = 0;
          projectionFailureArmed = true;
        }
        return result;
      });
      projectionMode = 'reserve-readback-then-fail';
      operationReads = 0;
      const preparedResponse = await request(app.getHttpServer()).post(`/api/bff/message-templates/${prepared.id}/submit`)
        .set('Cookie', cookie).set('x-requested-with', 'teste').set('idempotency-key', '45450f2a-4019-4c72-bd75-01f13d2f1001')
        .send({ expectedRevision: 1, expectedGeneration: createdChannel.channel.generation,
          expectedDefinitionFingerprint: prepared.definitionFingerprint }).expect(503);
      expect(preparedResponse.body).toMatchObject({ code: 'TEMPLATE_SUBMISSION_LOCAL_INCOMPLETE', operationId: expect.any(String),
        phase: 'PREPARED', providerAcceptance: 'UNKNOWN', receiptPersistence: 'RECORDED', projectionPersistence: 'UNCONFIRMED' });
      expect(fetchMock).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
      const preparedState = await prisma.messageTemplateOperation.findUniqueOrThrow({ where: { id: preparedResponse.body.operationId },
        include: { reservation: true, draft: { select: { state: true } }, receipts: true } });
      expect(preparedState).toMatchObject({ phase: 'PREPARED', reservation: { operationId: preparedResponse.body.operationId },
        draft: { state: 'LOCKED' }, receipts: [{ phase: 'PREPARED', safeCode: 'RESERVED' }] });

      const rejected = await app.get(TemplateDraftService).createDraft(ownerId, { buId, channelId: createdChannel.channel.id,
        expectedGeneration: createdChannel.channel.generation, clientRequestId: 'projection-rejected',
        definition: { ...definition, name: 'projection_rejected' } });
      projectionMode = 'release-projection-fail'; operationReads = 0;
      const rejectedResponse = await request(app.getHttpServer()).post(`/api/bff/message-templates/${rejected.id}/submit`)
        .set('Cookie', cookie).set('x-requested-with', 'teste').set('idempotency-key', '45450f2a-4019-4c72-bd75-01f13d2f1002')
        .send({ expectedRevision: 1, expectedGeneration: createdChannel.channel.generation,
          expectedDefinitionFingerprint: rejected.definitionFingerprint }).expect(503);
      expect(rejectedResponse.body).toMatchObject({ code: 'TEMPLATE_SUBMISSION_LOCAL_INCOMPLETE', operationId: expect.any(String),
        outcome: 'REJECTED', phase: 'REJECTED', receiptPersistence: 'RECORDED', projectionPersistence: 'UNCONFIRMED' });
      const rejectedState = await prisma.messageTemplateOperation.findUniqueOrThrow({ where: { id: rejectedResponse.body.operationId },
        include: { reservation: true, draft: { select: { state: true } }, receipts: { orderBy: { sequence: 'desc' }, take: 1 } } });
      expect(rejectedState).toMatchObject({ phase: 'REJECTED', reservation: null, draft: { state: 'DRAFT' }, receipts: [{ phase: 'REJECTED' }] });
      expect(fetchMock.mock.calls.filter((call) => String(call[0]).endsWith('/message_templates')).length).toBe(1);
    } finally { submission.prisma = originalPrisma; vi.restoreAllMocks(); vi.unstubAllGlobals(); }
  });

  it('rejects unknown request fields and malformed idempotency identifiers before resolving a channel', async () => {

      await postDraft('ee6aef26-d942-4c8e-a36b-cbdaff86490d', 'bff_accepted').expect(200);

        .set('Cookie', adminCookie).set('x-requested-with', 'teste').send({}).expect(200);

      const boundary = app.get<TemplateTransactionBoundary>(TEMPLATE_TRANSACTION_BOUNDARY);

        return new Proxy(delegate as object, { get(modelDelegate, method) {

          .send({ expectedRevision: 1, expectedGeneration: createdChannel.channel.generation,

        expect(ackUnconfirmed.body).toMatchObject({ code: 'TEMPLATE_SUBMISSION_LOCAL_INCOMPLETE', outcome: 'ACCEPTED',
          phase: 'ACCEPTED', operationId: expect.any(String), providerAcceptance: 'CONFIRMED',
          receiptPersistence: 'RECORDED', projectionPersistence: 'UNCONFIRMED',
          message: 'A Meta aceitou o cadastro, mas a conclusão local não foi confirmada; consulte esta operação antes de continuar' });
        const durableAck = await prisma.messageTemplateOperation.findUniqueOrThrow({ where: { id: ackUnconfirmed.body.operationId },
          include: { reservation: true, draft: { select: { state: true, revision: true } },
            receipts: { orderBy: { sequence: 'desc' }, take: 1 } } });
        expect(durableAck).toMatchObject({ phase: 'ACCEPTED', acceptanceProvenance: 'ACKNOWLEDGED',
          reservation: { operationId: ackUnconfirmed.body.operationId }, draft: { state: 'LOCKED', revision: 1 },
          receipts: [{ phase: 'ACCEPTED', acceptanceProvenance: 'ACKNOWLEDGED' }] });
        const ackReplay = await request(app.getHttpServer()).post(`/api/bff/message-templates/${ackUnconfirmedDraft.body.id}/submit`)
          .set('Cookie', cookie).set('x-requested-with', 'teste').set('idempotency-key', '908d3db9-f890-45bb-a65d-1cb459a60003')
          .send({ expectedRevision: 1, expectedGeneration: createdChannel.channel.generation,
            expectedDefinitionFingerprint: ackUnconfirmedDraft.body.definitionFingerprint }).expect(200);
        expect(ackReplay.body).toMatchObject({ id: ackUnconfirmed.body.operationId, phase: 'ACCEPTED' });
      } finally { boundarySpy.mockRestore(); submission.prisma = originalPrisma; }
      expect(postCalls).toBe(3);

      const actions = await prisma.activityLog.findMany({ where: { mantenedoraId }, select: {
        action: true, userId: true, buId: true, entidadeId: true, detalhe: true, texto: true,
      } });
      const templateActions = actions.filter((row) => row.action.startsWith('template.'));
      expect(templateActions.map((row) => row.action).sort()).toEqual([
        'template.operacao.reconciliada',
        'template.revisao.salva',
        'template.rascunho.criado', 'template.rascunho.criado', 'template.rascunho.criado',
        'template.submissao.iniciada', 'template.submissao.iniciada', 'template.submissao.iniciada',
      ].sort());
      expect(templateActions.filter((row) => row.action !== 'template.operacao.reconciliada')
        .every((row) => row.userId === ownerId)).toBe(true);
      expect(templateActions.filter((row) => row.action === 'template.operacao.reconciliada')
        .every((row) => row.userId === adminId)).toBe(true);
      expect(templateActions.every((row) => row.buId === buId && row.entidadeId && row.detalhe === null)).toBe(true);
      expect(templateActions.map((row) => row.texto)).not.toContain('Oi {{first_name}}.');
      expect(templateActions.map((row) => row.texto)).not.toContain('Ana');
    } finally { vi.unstubAllGlobals(); }
  });
});
```

```text
import { INestApplication } from '@nestjs/common';
import { Prisma } from '@prisma/client';
import { afterAll, beforeAll, beforeEach, describe, expect, it } from 'vitest';

import { PrismaService } from '../src/infra/prisma/prisma.service';
import { criarCanalVerificado, criarMantenedora, criarUsuario, limparBanco, subirApp } from './helpers';

  let prisma: PrismaService;
  let buId: string;
  let mantenedoraId: string;
  let channelId: string;
  let identityId: string;
  let resourceId: string;
  let ownerId: string;
  let peerId: string;
  let tenant: Awaited<ReturnType<typeof criarMantenedora>>;
  let service: TemplateDraftService;
  const providerCalls = { create: 0, list: 0, get: 0 };
  const definition: TemplateDefinition = {
    name: 'hello_user', language: 'pt_BR', category: 'UTILITY',
    body: 'Olá {{first_name}}.', examples: { first_name: 'Ana' },
  };

  beforeAll(async () => { ({ app, prisma } = await subirApp()); });
  beforeEach(async () => {
    await limparBanco(prisma);
    tenant = await criarMantenedora(app, 'Template draft tenant', 'template-draft-owner@example.test');
    mantenedoraId = tenant.mantenedora.id;
    buId = tenant.businessUnit.id;
    ownerId = tenant.owner.id;
    peerId = await criarUsuario(prisma, mantenedoraId, buId, `template-peer-${Date.now()}@example.test`, 'ATENDENTE');
    resourceId = `template-phone-${Date.now()}`;
    const channel = await criarCanalVerificado(prisma, buId, 'OFICIAL', resourceId);
    channelId = channel.channel.id;
    identityId = channel.identity.id;
    const resolver = {
      async resolve(reference: { buId: string; channelId: string; expectedGeneration: number }, options?: { transaction?: Prisma.TransactionClient }) {
        const database = options?.transaction ?? prisma;
        const current = await database.buChannel.findUniqueOrThrow({ where: { id: reference.channelId },
          include: { bu: { select: { mantenedoraId: true } } } });
        const currentCredential = await database.channelCredential.findUniqueOrThrow({ where: { channelId: reference.channelId } });
        return {
          context: {
            mantenedoraId: current.bu.mantenedoraId,
            buId: current.buId, channelId: current.id, providerResourceIdentityId: identityId,
            generation: current.generation, pairingEpoch: current.pairingEpoch, activeCredentialVersion: currentCredential.version,
            accountReference: 'opaque-template-account' as never,
          },
          provider: {
            async createTemplate() { providerCalls.create += 1; return { kind: 'ACCEPTED' as const, dispatched: true as const, remoteTemplateId: 'remote' }; },
            async listTemplates() { providerCalls.list += 1; return { templates: [], nextCursor: null }; },
            async getTemplate() { providerCalls.get += 1; return { remoteTemplateId: 'remote', status: 'UNKNOWN' as const, name: null, language: null, category: 'UNKNOWN' as const, parameterFormat: 'UNKNOWN' as const, components: [], supported: false, semanticFingerprint: null }; },
          },
        };
      },
    };
    service = new TemplateDraftService(prisma, app.get(AccessService), resolver as never,
      app.get(RegistroDeAtividade), app.get(TemplateObservationService));
  });
  afterAll(async () => { if (prisma) await limparBanco(prisma); await app?.close(); });

  const createInput = (clientRequestId = 'request-1') => ({ buId, channelId, expectedGeneration: 1, clientRequestId, definition });

  it('creates, lists, reads and saves immutable revision snapshots with compare-and-swap', async () => {
    const first = await service.createDraft(ownerId, createInput());
    expect(first.revision).toBe(1);
    expect(first).not.toHaveProperty('accountReference');
    expect(first).not.toHaveProperty('providerResourceIdentityId');
    const replay = await service.createDraft(ownerId, createInput());
    expect(replay.id).toBe(first.id);
    await expect(service.createDraft(ownerId, { ...createInput(), definition: { ...definition, body: 'Olá {{first_name}} alterado.' } })).rejects.toMatchObject({ status: 409 });

    const other = await service.createDraft(peerId, createInput('request-peer'));
    expect((await service.listDrafts(ownerId, buId)).items.map((item) => item.id)).toEqual([first.id]);
    expect((await service.listDrafts(ownerId, buId, { view: 'bu' })).items.map((item) => item.id)).toContain(other.id);
    expect((await service.getDraft(ownerId, buId, first.id)).id).toBe(first.id);
    await expect(service.getDraft(peerId, buId, first.id)).rejects.toMatchObject({ status: 404 });

    const updated = { ...definition, body: 'Até logo {{first_name}}!' };
    const saved = await service.saveDraft(ownerId, { buId, draftId: first.id, expectedGeneration: 1, expectedRevision: 1, definition: updated });
    expect(saved.revision).toBe(2);
    expect(saved.definitionFingerprint).toMatch(/^[a-f0-9]{64}$/);
    await expect(service.saveDraft(ownerId, { buId, draftId: first.id, expectedGeneration: 1, expectedRevision: 1, definition })).rejects.toMatchObject({ status: 409 });
    expect(await prisma.messageTemplateRevision.findMany({ where: { draftId: first.id }, orderBy: { revision: 'asc' } })).toHaveLength(2);
    await expect(prisma.messageTemplateRevision.update({ where: { draftId_revision: { draftId: first.id, revision: 1 } }, data: { definition: { ...definition, body: 'tampered' } } })).rejects.toThrow();
    await expect(prisma.messageTemplateRevision.delete({ where: { draftId_revision: { draftId: first.id, revision: 1 } } })).rejects.toThrow();
    expect(providerCalls).toEqual({ create: 0, list: 0, get: 0 });
  });

  it('keeps Prisma scalar and enum mappings aligned with every template table in PostgreSQL', async () => {
    const models = Prisma.dmmf.datamodel.models.filter((model) => model.name.startsWith('MessageTemplate'));
    const actual = await prisma.$queryRaw<Array<{ tableName: string; columnName: string }>>`
      SELECT table_name AS "tableName", column_name AS "columnName"
      FROM information_schema.columns
      WHERE table_schema = current_schema()
        AND table_name IN (${Prisma.join(models.map((model) => model.dbName ?? model.name))})
    `;
    const actualColumns = new Set(actual.map((column) => `${column.tableName}.${column.columnName}`));
    const expectedColumns = models.flatMap((model) => model.fields
      .filter((field) => field.kind === 'scalar' || field.kind === 'enum')
      .map((field) => `${model.dbName ?? model.name}.${field.dbName ?? field.name}`));
    expect(actualColumns, 'Every Prisma template scalar must resolve to a real column in the disposable PostgreSQL schema.')
      .toEqual(new Set(expectedColumns));
  });

  it('allows exactly one concurrent save at a revision and retains the winning history', async () => {
    const draft = await service.createDraft(ownerId, createInput('race'));
    const saves = await Promise.allSettled([
      service.saveDraft(ownerId, { buId, draftId: draft.id, expectedGeneration: 1, expectedRevision: 1, definition: { ...definition, body: 'Primeiro {{first_name}}!' } }),
      service.saveDraft(ownerId, { buId, draftId: draft.id, expectedGeneration: 1, expectedRevision: 1, definition: { ...definition, body: 'Segundo {{first_name}}!' } }),
    ]);
    expect(saves.filter((result) => result.status === 'fulfilled')).toHaveLength(1);
    expect(saves.filter((result) => result.status === 'rejected')).toHaveLength(1);
    expect(await prisma.messageTemplateRevision.count({ where: { draftId: draft.id } })).toBe(2);
    expect((await service.getDraft(ownerId, buId, draft.id)).revision).toBe(2);
  });

  it('previews without writes or provider calls and marks edited linked definitions unpersisted', async () => {
    const draft = await service.createDraft(ownerId, createInput('preview'));
    const before = await prisma.messageTemplateDraft.count();
    const unchanged = await service.preview(ownerId, { buId, channelId, expectedGeneration: 1, draftId: draft.id, expectedRevision: 1, definition });
    const edited = await service.preview(ownerId, { buId, channelId, expectedGeneration: 1, draftId: draft.id, expectedRevision: 1, definition: { ...definition, body: 'Oi {{first_name}}.' } });
    expect(unchanged.persistence).toBe('PERSISTED');
    expect(edited.persistence).toBe('UNPERSISTED');
    expect(await prisma.messageTemplateDraft.count()).toBe(before);
    expect(providerCalls).toEqual({ create: 0, list: 0, get: 0 });
  });

  it('keeps draft history through channel detach and does not authorize a replacement channel', async () => {
    const draft = await service.createDraft(ownerId, createInput('detach'));
    const originalChannelId = channelId;
    const originalIdentityId = identityId;

    await expect(app.get(ChannelsService).desconectar(buId, 'OFICIAL')).resolves.toBe(true);
    expect(await prisma.buChannel.findUnique({ where: { id: originalChannelId } })).toBeNull();
    expect(await prisma.messageTemplateDraft.findUnique({ where: { id: draft.id } })).toMatchObject({
      id: draft.id, channelId: originalChannelId, revision: 1,
    });
    expect(await prisma.messageTemplateRevision.count({ where: { draftId: draft.id } })).toBe(1);
    expect(await prisma.providerResourceIdentity.findUniqueOrThrow({ where: { id: originalIdentityId } })).toMatchObject({
      currentChannelId: null,
    });

    await expect(prisma.businessUnit.delete({ where: { id: buId } })).rejects.toBeDefined();
    expect(await prisma.messageTemplateDraft.findUnique({ where: { id: draft.id } })).not.toBeNull();
    expect(await prisma.messageTemplateRevision.count({ where: { draftId: draft.id } })).toBe(1);
    const buDeleteRule = await prisma.$queryRaw<Array<{ onDelete: string }>>`
      SELECT confdeltype::text AS "onDelete" FROM pg_constraint
      WHERE conname = 'mt_draft_bu_fkey' AND conrelid = 'message_template_drafts'::regclass
    `;
    const channelForeignKey = await prisma.$queryRaw<Array<{ count: bigint }>>`
      SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT constraint_row.oid) AS count
      FROM pg_constraint AS constraint_row
      JOIN unnest(constraint_row.conkey) AS key_column(attnum) ON TRUE
      JOIN pg_attribute AS column_row ON column_row.attrelid = constraint_row.conrelid AND column_row.attnum = key_column.attnum
      WHERE constraint_row.contype = 'f' AND constraint_row.conrelid = 'message_template_drafts'::regclass
        AND column_row.attname = 'channel_id'
    `;
    expect(buDeleteRule).toEqual([{ onDelete: 'r' }]);
    expect(channelForeignKey[0]?.count).toBe(0n);

    const replacement = await criarCanalVerificado(prisma, buId, 'OFICIAL', resourceId);
    expect(replacement.identity.id).toBe(originalIdentityId);
    expect(replacement.channel.id).not.toBe(originalChannelId);
    channelId = replacement.channel.id;
    identityId = replacement.identity.id;
    await expect(service.saveDraft(ownerId, {
      buId, draftId: draft.id, expectedGeneration: replacement.channel.generation,
      expectedRevision: 1, definition: { ...definition, body: 'Mudança {{first_name}}.' },
    })).rejects.toMatchObject({ status: 409 });
    expect(await prisma.messageTemplateDraft.findUniqueOrThrow({ where: { id: draft.id } })).toMatchObject({
      channelId: originalChannelId, revision: 1,
    });
    expect(await prisma.messageTemplateRevision.count({ where: { draftId: draft.id } })).toBe(1);
  });

  it('revalida a mesma ligação histórica com geração/credencial atuais e recalcula o fingerprint', async () => {
    const draft = await service.createDraft(ownerId, createInput('reauth'));
    const originalFingerprint = draft.definitionFingerprint;
    await prisma.buChannel.update({ where: { id: channelId }, data: { generation: 2 } });
    await prisma.channelCredential.update({ where: { channelId }, data: { generation: 2, version: 2 } });
    const saved = await service.saveDraft(ownerId, {
      buId, draftId: draft.id, expectedGeneration: 2, expectedRevision: 1,
      definition: { ...definition, body: 'Atualizado {{first_name}}.' },
    });
    expect(saved.definitionFingerprint).toMatch(/^[a-f0-9]{64}$/);
    expect(saved.definitionFingerprint).not.toBe(originalFingerprint);
    expect(saved.channelId).toBe(channelId);
    expect(saved.revision).toBe(2);
    expect(await prisma.messageTemplateRevision.count({ where: { draftId: draft.id } })).toBe(2);
  });

  it('denies forged cross-tenant grants and foreign actors before resolving a channel or touching drafts', async () => {
    const foreignTenant = await criarMantenedora(app, 'Different template tenant', `template-different-${Date.now()}@example.test`);
    const foreignUserId = foreignTenant.owner.id;
    await prisma.userBuRole.create({ data: { userId: foreignUserId, buId, role: 'OWNER', grantedViaTipo: 'DIRETO' } });
    const before = providerCalls.create;
    await expect(service.createDraft(foreignUserId, createInput('foreign'))).rejects.toMatchObject({ status: 404 });
    await expect(service.createDraft(peerId, { ...createInput('wrong-bu'), buId: foreignTenant.businessUnit.id })).rejects.toMatchObject({ status: 404 });
    expect(providerCalls.create).toBe(before);
    expect(await prisma.messageTemplateDraft.count()).toBe(0);
  });

  it('applies stable pagination defaults and caps page size at 50', async () => {
    for (let index = 0; index < 22; index += 1) await service.createDraft(ownerId, createInput(`page-${index}`));
    const page = await service.listDrafts(ownerId, buId);
    expect(page.items).toHaveLength(20);
    expect(page.page).toBe(1);
    const capped = await service.listDrafts(ownerId, buId, { limit: 500 });
    expect(capped.items).toHaveLength(22);
    expect(capped.limit).toBe(50);
  });

  it('rejects an unknown list view instead of widening it to the whole BU', async () => {
    await service.createDraft(ownerId, createInput('view-owner'));
    await service.createDraft(peerId, { ...createInput('view-peer'), definition });
    await expect(service.listDrafts(ownerId, buId, { view: 'mine' })).resolves.toMatchObject({ total: 1 });
    await expect(service.listDrafts(ownerId, buId, { view: 'all' as never })).rejects.toMatchObject({ status: 400 });
  });
});
```

```text
import { afterAll, beforeAll, beforeEach, describe, expect, it, vi } from 'vitest';
import { createHash, randomUUID } from 'node:crypto';
import request from 'supertest';
import type { Prisma } from '@prisma/client';
import { TEMPLATE_MANAGEMENT_RESOLVER, type TemplateManagementResolver } from '../src/domain/message-templates/template-management.ports';
import { TemplateDraftService } from '../src/domain/message-templates/template-draft.service';
import { TemplateSubmissionService } from '../src/domain/message-templates/template-submission.service';
import { TEMPLATE_TRANSACTION_BOUNDARY, type TemplateTransactionBoundary } from '../src/domain/message-templates/template-transaction-boundary';
import { TEMPLATE_OBSERVATION_CLOCK, TemplateObservationService, type TemplateObservationClock } from '../src/domain/message-templates/template-observation.service';
import { sealChannelCredential } from '../src/domain/channels/channel-credential-crypto';
import { templateDefinitionSemanticFingerprint } from '../src/domain/message-templates/template-definition';
import { PrismaService } from '../src/infra/prisma/prisma.service';
import { criarCanalVerificado, criarMantenedora, criarUsuario, limparBanco, login, META_APP_SECRET, subirApp } from './helpers';

function response(status: number, payload: unknown): Response {
  return new Response(JSON.stringify(payload), { status, headers: { 'content-type': 'application/json' } });
}

function deferred<T>() {
  let resolve!: (value: T) => void;
  const promise = new Promise<T>((done) => { resolve = done; });
  return { promise, resolve };
}

async function withReadbackFailure<T>(service: TemplateSubmissionService,
  model: 'messageTemplateOperation' | 'messageTemplateSubmissionReceipt', action: 'findFirst', run: () => Promise<T>): Promise<T> {
  const target = service as unknown as { prisma: PrismaService };
  const original = target.prisma;
  let pending = true;
  target.prisma = new Proxy(original, { get(prisma, property) {
    const delegate = Reflect.get(prisma, property, prisma);
    if (property !== model || !delegate || typeof delegate !== 'object') return delegate;
    return new Proxy(delegate as object, { get(modelDelegate, method) {
      const value = Reflect.get(modelDelegate, method, modelDelegate);
      if (method === action && pending) {
        pending = false;
        return () => Promise.reject(new Error('injected PostgreSQL readback unavailable'));
      }
      return value;
    } });
  } });
  try { return await run(); }
  finally { target.prisma = original; }
}

describe('scoped template-management provider (PostgreSQL)', () => {
  let app: Awaited<ReturnType<typeof subirApp>>['app'];

  it('fails closed when channel generation rotates while the grant check is held before dispatch', async () => {
    const draft = await app.get(TemplateDraftService).createDraft(ownerId, { buId, channelId: channel1,
      expectedGeneration: 1, clientRequestId: 'held-grant-generation-rotation',
      definition: { name: 'held_grant_rotation', language: 'pt_BR', category: 'UTILITY',
        body: 'Olá {{first_name}}.', examples: { first_name: 'Ana' } } });
    const grantStarted = deferred<void>();
    const grantHold = deferred<Response>();
    let pending: ReturnType<TemplateSubmissionService['submitDraft']> | undefined;
    let listGets = 0;
    let posts = 0;
    const fetchMock = vi.fn(async (input: RequestInfo | URL, init: RequestInit = {}) => {
      const url = String(input); const method = init.method ?? 'GET';
      if (url.includes('/debug_token') && method === 'GET') {
        grantStarted.resolve();
        return grantHold.promise;
      }
      if (url.includes('/message_templates?') && method === 'GET') { listGets += 1; return response(200, { data: [] }); }
      if (url.endsWith('/message_templates') && method === 'POST') { posts += 1; return response(200, { id: 'must-not-dispatch' }); }
      throw new Error(`unexpected held-grant request ${method} ${url}`);
    });
    vi.stubGlobal('fetch', fetchMock);
    try {
      pending = app.get(TemplateSubmissionService).submitDraft(ownerId, { draftId: draft.id,
        expectedRevision: 1, expectedGeneration: 1, expectedDefinitionFingerprint: draft.definitionFingerprint,
        idempotencyKey: 'ac120b9a-50d0-4e33-bc2d-dc5899d540a1' });
      await grantStarted.promise;
      await prisma.buChannel.update({ where: { id: channel1 }, data: { generation: 2 } });
      grantHold.resolve(response(200, { data: { app_id: 'fixture-app', is_valid: true,
        scopes: ['whatsapp_business_management'], granular_scopes: [{ scope: 'whatsapp_business_management', target_ids: ['waba-a'] }] } }));
      const result = await pending;
      expect(result).toMatchObject({ phase: 'REJECTED', safeCode: 'PRE_DISPATCH_UNAVAILABLE' });
      expect(listGets).toBe(1);
      expect(posts).toBe(0);
      expect(await prisma.messageTemplateNameReservation.count({ where: { operationId: result.id } })).toBe(0);
    } finally {
      grantHold.resolve(response(200, { data: { app_id: 'fixture-app', is_valid: true,
        scopes: ['whatsapp_business_management'], granular_scopes: [{ scope: 'whatsapp_business_management', target_ids: ['waba-a'] }] } }));
      if (pending) await Promise.allSettled([pending]);
      vi.unstubAllGlobals();
    }
  });

  it('fences twenty concurrent saves through each transaction connection without pool starvation', async () => {
    const service = app.get(TemplateDraftService);
    const createdDrafts = await Promise.allSettled(Array.from({ length: 20 }, (_, index) => service.createDraft(ownerId, {
      buId, channelId: channel1, expectedGeneration: 1, clientRequestId: `pool-fence-${index}`,
      definition: { name: `pool_fence_${index}`, language: 'pt_BR', category: 'UTILITY', body: 'Olá {{first_name}}.', examples: { first_name: 'Ana' } },
    })));
    expect(createdDrafts.every((result) => result.status === 'fulfilled')).toBe(true);
    const drafts = createdDrafts.map((result) => {
      if (result.status === 'rejected') throw result.reason;
      return result.value;
    });
    const saveResults = await Promise.allSettled(drafts.map((draft, index) => service.saveDraft(ownerId, {
      buId, draftId: draft.id, expectedGeneration: 1, expectedRevision: 1,
      definition: { name: `pool_fence_${index}`, language: 'pt_BR', category: 'UTILITY', body: `Oi {{first_name}} ${index}.`, examples: { first_name: 'Ana' } },
    })));
    expect(saveResults.every((result) => result.status === 'fulfilled')).toBe(true);
    const saves = saveResults.map((result) => {
      if (result.status === 'rejected') throw result.reason;
      return result.value;
    });
    expect(saves).toHaveLength(20);
    expect(saves.every((saved) => saved.revision === 2)).toBe(true);
    expect(await prisma.messageTemplateRevision.count({ where: { draftId: { in: drafts.map((draft) => draft.id) } } })).toBe(40);
  }, 20_000);

      expect(calls.filter(({ url, method }) => url.endsWith('/message_templates') && method === 'POST')).toHaveLength(0);

      expect(await prisma.messageTemplateSubmissionReceipt.findMany({ where: { operationId: operation.id },
        orderBy: { sequence: 'asc' }, select: { sequence: true, phase: true, safeCode: true } })).toEqual([

      expect(await prisma.messageTemplateDraft.findUniqueOrThrow({ where: { id: draft.id }, select: { state: true, revision: true } }))
        .toEqual({ state: 'DRAFT', revision: 1 });
    } finally { vi.unstubAllGlobals(); }

        .send({ expectedRevision: 1, expectedGeneration: 1, expectedDefinitionFingerprint: draft.definitionFingerprint });
      expect(submitted.status).toBe(201);
      const operationId = submitted.body.id as string;
      const catalogPageCount = await prisma.messageTemplateCatalogPage.count();
      expect(catalogPageCount).toBe(0);
      const refresh = await request(app.getHttpServer()).post(`/api/bff/message-templates/${draft.id}/refresh`)
        .set('Cookie', cookie).set('x-requested-with', 'teste').send({});
      expect(refresh.status).toBe(200);
      expect(refresh.body).toMatchObject({ status: 'PAUSED', available: true, eligible: false, eligibleForUse: false });
      const callsAfterRefresh = fetchMock.mock.calls.length;
      const observedIdentity = await prisma.messageTemplateRemoteObservation.findFirstOrThrow({
        where: { remoteTemplateId: remoteId }, select: { contextKey: true },
      });
      const contextKey = observedIdentity.contextKey;
      const storedBefore = await prisma.messageTemplateRemoteObservation.findUniqueOrThrow({
        where: { contextKey_remoteTemplateId: { contextKey, remoteTemplateId: remoteId } },
      });
      const opBefore = await prisma.messageTemplateOperation.findUniqueOrThrow({ where: { id: operationId } });
      const receiptCountBefore = await prisma.messageTemplateSubmissionReceipt.count({ where: { operationId } });

      const detail = await request(app.getHttpServer()).get(`/api/bff/message-templates/${draft.id}`).set('Cookie', cookie);
      const operation = await request(app.getHttpServer()).get(`/api/bff/message-templates/${draft.id}/operations/${operationId}`).set('Cookie', cookie);
      expect(detail.status).toBe(200);
      expect(operation.status).toBe(200);
      expect(detail.body.savedObservation).toMatchObject({ status: 'PAUSED', available: true,
        eligible: false, eligibleForUse: false, matchesDefinition: true });
      expect(detail.body.currentOperation.savedObservation).toMatchObject({ status: 'PAUSED', observedFence: refresh.body.observedFence });
      expect(operation.body.savedObservation).toMatchObject({ status: 'PAUSED', observedFence: refresh.body.observedFence });
      expect(fetchMock).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(callsAfterRefresh);
      expect(await prisma.messageTemplateCatalogPage.count()).toBe(0);
      expect(await prisma.messageTemplateRemoteObservation.findUniqueOrThrow({
        where: { contextKey_remoteTemplateId: { contextKey, remoteTemplateId: remoteId } },
      })).toEqual(storedBefore);
      expect(await prisma.messageTemplateOperation.findUniqueOrThrow({ where: { id: operationId } })).toEqual(opBefore);
      expect(await prisma.messageTemplateSubmissionReceipt.count({ where: { operationId } })).toBe(receiptCountBefore);

      now = new Date(now.getTime() + 301_000);
      const expired = await request(app.getHttpServer()).get(`/api/bff/message-templates/${draft.id}`).set('Cookie', cookie);
      expect(expired.body.savedObservation).toMatchObject({ status: 'PAUSED', available: false, eligible: false, eligibleForUse: false });
      expect(fetchMock).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(callsAfterRefresh);
      await prisma.buChannel.update({ where: { id: channel1 }, data: { wabaId: 'waba-saved-observation-replaced' } });
      const staleContext = await request(app.getHttpServer()).get(`/api/bff/message-templates/${draft.id}`).set('Cookie', cookie);
      expect(staleContext.status).toBe(200);
      expect(staleContext.body.savedObservation).toMatchObject({ status: 'PAUSED', available: false,
        eligible: false, eligibleForUse: false, safeCode: 'TEMPLATE_CONTEXT_STALE' });
      expect(fetchMock).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(callsAfterRefresh);
      expect(await prisma.messageTemplateRemoteObservation.findUniqueOrThrow({
        where: { contextKey_remoteTemplateId: { contextKey, remoteTemplateId: remoteId } },
      })).toEqual(storedBefore);
      expect(await prisma.messageTemplateCatalogPage.count()).toBe(0);
    } finally { clockSpy.mockRestore(); vi.unstubAllGlobals(); }
  });

          language: 'pt_BR', status: 'PENDING', category: 'UTILITY', parameter_format: 'NAMED',

      }
      if (url.endsWith('/message_templates') && method === 'POST') throw new Error('fixture timeout after dispatch');
      throw new Error(`unexpected template request ${method} ${url}`);
    });
    vi.stubGlobal('fetch', fetchMock);
    try {
      const input = { draftId: draft.id, expectedRevision: 1, expectedGeneration: 1, expectedDefinitionFingerprint: draft.definitionFingerprint, idempotencyKey: 'd8b515eb-4a6c-45b4-af76-c9258b77a76f' };
      await expect(submissions.submitDraft(ownerId, input)).rejects.toMatchObject({ status: 503, response: {
        code: 'TEMPLATE_SUBMISSION_UNCERTAIN', phase: 'AMBIGUOUS', outcome: 'PROVIDER_RESULT_UNCERTAIN', receiptPersistence: 'RECORDED',
      } });

      const replay = await submissions.submitDraft(ownerId, input);
      expect(replay).toMatchObject({ id: ambiguous.id, phase: 'AMBIGUOUS' });
      expect(fetchMock).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(callsAfterDispatch);
      expect(calls.filter(({ url }) => url.includes('/debug_token'))).toHaveLength(1);
      expect(calls.filter(({ url, method }) => url.includes('/message_templates?') && method === 'GET')).toHaveLength(1);
      expect(calls.filter(({ url, method }) => url.endsWith('/message_templates') && method === 'POST')).toHaveLength(1);
      const correlated = await submissions.reconcile(ownerId, draft.id, ambiguous.id);
      expect(correlated).toMatchObject({ phase: 'ACCEPTED', providerAcceptance: 'UNKNOWN', remoteTemplateId: 'late-visible-id' });
      expect(await prisma.messageTemplateOperation.findUniqueOrThrow({ where: { id: ambiguous.id }, select: {
        phase: true, acceptanceProvenance: true, safeCode: true,
      } })).toEqual({ phase: 'ACCEPTED', acceptanceProvenance: 'CORRELATED_BY_DEFINITION', safeCode: 'CORRELATED_BY_DEFINITION' });
      expect(await prisma.messageTemplateSubmissionReceipt.findFirst({ where: { operationId: ambiguous.id }, orderBy: { sequence: 'desc' }, select: {
        phase: true, acceptanceProvenance: true, safeCode: true,
      } })).toEqual({ phase: 'ACCEPTED', acceptanceProvenance: 'CORRELATED_BY_DEFINITION', safeCode: 'CORRELATED_BY_DEFINITION' });
      expect(calls.filter(({ url }) => url.includes('/debug_token'))).toHaveLength(2);
      expect(calls.filter(({ url, method }) => url.includes('/message_templates?') && method === 'GET')).toHaveLength(2);
      expect(calls.filter(({ url, method }) => url.endsWith('/message_templates') && method === 'POST')).toHaveLength(1);
    } finally { vi.unstubAllGlobals(); }
  });
```
